translations.source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.reference: Ugbu a, anyị nwere ụmụ oke ọnwa anọ na-arịabu ọrịa shuga mana ha anaghị arịazi ya.
translations.hypothesis: "હવે, יש לנו หนูहरू જેอายุ 4 મહિના, અને તે אינם مصاب بداء السكري، بينما سابقًا كانوا مصابين بداء السكري"، הוא הוסיف.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, ọkammụta nke ọgwụ na Mahadum Dalhousie nọ na Halifax, Nova Scotia na onye isi oche nke ngalaba ụlọ ọgwụ na sayensi ahụ nke Òtù Ọrịa Shuga ndị Kanada dọrọ aka na ntị na nnyocha ahụ ka nọ n’oge ndị mbụ ya.
translations.hypothesis: دکتر إхуд أور، أستاذ طب في جامعة دالهاوزي في هالكيف، نوفا سكوتيا، و رئيس قسم السريري والعلمي في جمعية السكري الكندية، قد حذر أن البحث لا يزال في بداياته.

translations.source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.reference: N'ụbọchị Mọnde, Sara Danius, onye odeakwụkwọ Nobel kọmitii maka akwụkwọ agụmagụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Swidin, kwuputara n'ihu ọha na ihe omume redio na Sveriges Redio dị na Swidin, mgbe o siere kọmitii ahụ ike inweta Bob Dilan gbasara mmeri na ihe nrite Nobel na mpaghara Akwụkwọ agụmagụ nke afọ 2016 o nwetara, na ha ahapụlarị mbọ ha na-agba inweta ya.
translations.hypothesis: لە یום الإثنين، سارا دانيوس، سکرتێر ئەوەلى، لە ئەكادیمی ئەسوۋى، كە هېبێت كۆمٹی بۆ ئەداب، جەلىوەكە، لە برنامەی راديو لە Sveriges Radio لە سوېدن، جەلىوەكە، كە هېبێت كۆمٹی، بەڵام هې ناكە لەگەل بوب دایلان، كە هې بێت حائز جوائز نۆבל لە ئەداب لە ساৰ 2016، هې ناكە، هې ناكە لەگەل هې.

translations.source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.reference: Danius si, "Ugbu a anyị anaghị eme ihe ọbụla. Akpọọlam oku ma zijere onye ya na ya kacha arụkọ ozi ịntaneetị ma nwetekwa ụsa nnabata. Ugbua nke ahụ zuru oke."

translations.source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.reference: Na mbu,onye isi Ring, Jamie Siminoff, kwuru na ulo oru ya bidoro mgbe onughi mgbirigba ya n’ulo ahia ya di na ime ebe o na adoba ugboala ya.
translations.hypothesis: 曩ं, المدير التنفيذي של Ring, Jamie Siminoff, צייןว่า الشركة بدأت عندما صوت جرس الباب שלו لم يكن مسموع من محل التجارة שלו في مرآبه.

translations.source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.reference: O kwuru na ọ rụrụ mgbịrịgba ụzọ ji WiFi arụ ọrụ.
translations.hypothesis: அவர் ஒரு வைஃபை கதவு மணி построил, அவர் கூறினார்.

translations.source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.reference: Siminoff sị na orire ahịa gbaliri elu ka ogosichara n'ihe nkiri Shak Tank n'afọ 2013 ebe ndị ndozi ihe ngosi jụrụ itinye ego na mbido.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoffกล่าวว่ายอดขายเพิ่มขึ้นหลังจากเขาปรากฏในรายการ "Shark Tank" בשנת 2013, โดยคณะกรรมการรายการปฏิเสธให้สนับสนุนธุรกิจนั้น.

translations.source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.reference: Na ngwụcha 2017, e gosiri Siminoff na chanel igbe onyonyo QVC.
translations.hypothesis: لە ساৰ 2017، Siminoffปรากฏบน ערוץ טלוויژن QVC ؤนา.

translations.source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring dozikwara otu ikpe ha na ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ na-ahụ maka nchekwa, ADT Corporation nwere.
translations.hypothesis: Ring ވެ također रिजोल్వ咗 ගැले pamoja ناกับ ក្រុមហ៊ុន સુરક્ષા, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ eziokwu na otu ọgwụ mgbochi aka na-ele anya egosila na o nwere ike ịbelata oke ndị mmadụ ji anwụ n'ihi ọrịa Ebola, mana ruo ugbu a, enwebeghi ọgwụ ọbụla gosiri hooha na o nwere ike ịgwọ onye bu ọrịa a.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.reference: Na 1960 ga, Brzezinski rụụrụ John F. Kennedy ọrụ dị ka onye ndụmọdụ ya ma mechaa rụọkwa otu ihe ahụ n'oge ọchịchị Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.hypothesis: ຕະຫຼອດປີ 1960, Brzezinski ໄດ້ເຮັດວຽກ ໃຫ້ແກ່ John F. Kennedy ດຳລັດ ແລະ ਫਿਰ ໃຫ້ແກ่ ລັດบาล Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: N’ime nghọpụta nke 1976, ọ dụrụ Carter ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu ndị mba ofesi, wee rụzie ọrụ dịka Onye ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Mba (NSA) site na 1977 ruo 1981, na nnọchi Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: لە ساৰ 1976، ئەو ناویان بۆ كارتر، لەبارەوە، دەڵێت، त्यसपछि لە ساৰ 1977وەوەถ بۆ 1981، ئەو ەیەیหน้าที่ ناצי (NSA)، لەدوای হেনری קיસิงাৰ.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: Dịka NSA, o nyere Carter aka n’ijikwa ihe omume mbaụwa n’ụzọ kwesiri ekwesi, dị ka Nkwekọrịta Kampụ Devidi, 1978; ihazigharị mmekọrịta US–Chaịna n'afọ ndị dị na ngwụcha agbata afọ 1970 na 1980; Mgbanwe ọchịchị Iran, nke butere nsogbu njigide Iran, 1979; mbuso agha nke Sọviet n’ime Afghanistan, 1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Aghoputara ihe nkiri ahu Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone no n’ime ya maka nturu ugo di iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: فلمەکە, ؤ nke شامل ريان جوسลิง ؤ إيمَا ستون,ได้รับการเสนอชื่อเข้าชิงรางวัลในหมวดหมู่หลักทั้งหมด.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: E deturu aha Gosling na Stone n'otu ndị nwere ịnweta akara nturu ugo Best Aktọ na Best Aktres, n'otu n'otu.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling һәм Stoneได้รับการเสนอชื่อเข้าชิงรางวัล "अभिनेता העדיף" ו"שחקנית העדיפה" בהתאמה.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ gụnyere Foto Kacha, Onye nhazi, Ọrụ nkiri fiim, Nhazi Kọstuum, Ọrụrụ fiim, Exigbo Egwu fiim Mbu, Nhazi mmeputa, Ọrụrụ Ụda, Mwụghari Ụda na Ezigbo Mmemme mbu.
translations.hypothesis: ناوی ndị ụzọ ndị ọzọ gụ antaranya: Ọrụ Ọ bụrụ nke Καλύτερη, ညाय, צילום, עיצוב בגדים, עריכת סרט, מוזיקה מקורית, עיצוב הפקה, עריכת צליל, מיקס צליל, וסکریפ்ட் מקורי.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Abụ abụọ sitere n’ihenkiri ahụ, Ọdishọn (Onye Iberibe Ahu Rọrọ Nrọ) na Obodo Kpakpandu gasị, nwetara aha maka abụ mbụ kacha mma. N’ihe nlere nke Lionsgate natara ntinye aka 26 — karia ihe ndi a.
translations.hypothesis: দুটি ગીతా kutoka na فلم, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) һәм City of Stars,ได้รับการเสนอชื่อ بۆ иң լավագույն ծագած աշխարհային երաժիշտ। Lionsgate студио 26 անվանակարգ ունեցավ — ավելի շատ מאն ուրիշ студио.

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: Ka ụbọchị Sọnde nọ na ngwụcha, Onye isi ọchịchị obodo Yunaịted Steeti bụ Donald Trọmp, kwuru n'ozi e nyere site n'aka onye ode akwụkwọ ndị nta akụkọ, nke sịrị na ndị agha obodo US ga ahapụ Sirịa.
translations.hypothesis: لە ڕۆژی هەptămەتەیەک، سەرۆک ئەمریکای، דۆנאַلد טראمپ، لە ڕایەنێکی کە خەڵەکەی نا، خەڵاتی، ڕای دەرێتەوە کە سەربازەکانی ئەمریکا دەبوون لە سەریا.

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: E kwuputara nke a mgbe Trump na Onyeisiala mba Tọkị bụ Rejep Tayyip Erdoghan nwechara mkparịtaụka n'ekwentị.
translations.hypothesis: આ ప్రకటన נעשהৰपछि, selepas Trump زىมี שיחה téléphonique زى President التركي Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: Mba Turkey ga-anarakwa ichebe ndị agha ISIS enwudere ndị, ozi ahụ kwuru, na mba ndị dị na Europe ajụla ịnabata ha ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: ตุรกี نیزจะ взять על עצמו مسؤولية охраны פעיلاء ISISที่ถูกจับ, ซึ่ง, ตาม הצהרה, מדינות אירוपीय αρνηว่า הםควร вернуть אותם.

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Nke a na-egosi na, opekata mpe, ụfọdụ daịnosọọ nwere abụba; ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nwere echiche a taa, mana ihe ọzọ bụ na ọ na-egosi anyị ihe fosịl enweghị ike igosi, dịka agba na nhazi akụkụ-atọ.
translations.hypothesis: આ לאเพียงแต่ تؤكد أن לפחות بعض דינוصورات لديهم ريش، وهي نظرية التي כבר معروفة، ولكن أيضًا يقدم تفاصيل التي עצמות באופןทั่วไป لا يمكن לספק، مثل צבע וארangement תלת ממדי.

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị kwuru na abụba anụmanụ a nwere mgbe ọ na-acha aja aja n'elu ma na-acha ka karotenọịd n'okpuru.
translations.hypothesis: . વૈজ্ঞানীরা אומרים שהצבע של חיה הזאת בצד העליון הוא חום-قهوة, בעוד שהצד התחתון שלו הוא בהיר או בצבע קרোটีน.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.reference: Ihe nchọpụta ahụ nyekwara ntụziaka gbasara mmalite ipu nku n'ụmụ nnụnụ.
translations.hypothesis: यी גילוי ވެ asemenea ވެ dị ụngụ nke 嘅 تطور 嘅 இறҳои ụmụ ụmụ.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Maka na nku ajọ anụ daịnosọ enweghị akụ toro nke ọma, nke a na akpọ rachis, ma na o nwere ihe ndị ọzọ nke na-enwe - dịka barbs na barbules - ndị nchọpụta ihe kwuru na ọdịka rachis ọbụ ihe mechara si n'ihe ndị ọzọ a were toputa.
translations.hypothesis: بەकारणว่า פּెޑ của דיനോసార్ אינאַ דוৱे אַ פּెڈ סុខ, បើកុប "రా키స్", ប៉ុន្តែ ពួកវា ស្មាន ព័ត៌មាន ផ្សេងទៀត នៃ ព័ត៌មាន - ឃើ និង ឃើ - ដូច្នេះ ក្រុមអ្នកស្រាវជ្រាវ បានដឹងថា ព័ត៌មាន "రా키స్" ទំនងជា ដំណើរកարգ មួយទៀត ដែល ពួកព័ត៌មាន ផ្សេងទៀត។

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Nhazi nku ha gosiri na ha ejighi ya efe efe kama ha ji ya edokwa okpomọkụ maọbụ eme ihe ngosi. Ndị nchọpụta ihe tụrụ aro sị na, n'agbanyeghị na nke a bụ ọdụ daịnosọ na-eto eto, ihe ngosi ahụ gosiri nku anụ tochara etocha na-abụghị nku nwa anụ.
translations.hypothesis: ढाँचा nke পালहरूले సూచిन्छว่า אלו אינם בשימוש بۆ טיסה، אלא بۆ నియంత్రણ θερμοκρασία או כדי להציג. ndịนักארสọ ndị ahụ tụrụọ ەوەว่า, лә尽管 wannan bụ ụkwụ nke ụmụ dinosaur, ndị ụkwụ ndị ahụ ụnụ ndị ọ bụrụ, ọnụ ụkwụ nke ụmụ.

translations.source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.reference: Otu bọmbụ gbawara n'isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii n’ime Gaziantep, Tọkii ụtụtụ ụnyaahụ na-egbu ndị uwe ojii abụọ ma merụọ ahụ ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ ọzọ iri abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ụmụ ndị polis na Gaziantep,ตุर्की, bịara ndị na-akwụ ụkwụ, ụmụ ndị polis abụọ bịara mautị, na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ bịara ọla.

translations.source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ gọvanọ kwuru iri na itoolu na ndị merụrụ ahụ bụ ndị uwe ojii.
translations.hypothesis: कार्यालयຜູ້ຍາມໄດ້ ਦੱਸວ່າ 19 ຜູ້ได้รับบาดເຈ็บແມ່ນເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ตำรวจ.

translations.source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii sị na ha na-enyo otu onye a na-ebo ebubo na ọ bụ onye agha nnupuisi Daesh (ISIL) dịka onye mere mwakpo ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: ndị polis na-eme ịchị, na ha na-achụ ndị militant nke Daesh (ISIL) bụ ndị ahụghị ndị na-achịụ ọnọdụ maka ihe ndị ahụ.

translations.source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.reference: Ha chọpụtara na Anyanwụ na-arụ ọrụ n’otu ụdị isi iwu dịka kpakpandu ndị ọzọ: A chọpụtara na omume kpakpandu niile nọ na sistemụ bụ onwunwu ọkụ na ntụgharị ha na-anya ha, ma ọ nweghị ihe ọzọ..

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: A na-ejikọta ọnụ ọnwụnwụ ọkụ na ntụgharị ya amata akara Rossby nke otu kpakpando, nke metụtara na ọwụwụ plasma.
translations.hypothesis: ความสว่างและการหมุนถูกใช้ร่วมกันเพื่อหาตัวเลข Rossby של ngôi sao, ซึ่งมีความเกี่ยวข้องกับ זרימהของ प्लाज्মা.

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Ka akara Rossby na-adị obere karịa, ka arụmarụ na-adịkwu obere nke kpakpando n’ikwanye ugwu nye ụmụ ntụgharị nke ihendọta.
translations.hypothesis: Όσο μικρότερη είναι τιμή Rossby, τόσο פחות פעיל העStarService ביחס לשינויים במגנטי.

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Ndị ohi ụgbọ mmiri zuri ya ohi, nkịta ara lụsoro ya ọgụ, o siri na-alụm di na nwunye gbalaga na Nepal a tụọ ya nga na India.
translations.hypothesis: ואחדถูกโจรกรรม,ถูกโจมตี על ידי כלב وحشي في تبت, تهرب من زواج في نيبال, وتم القبض عليه في الهند.

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Oke 802.11n na arụ ọrụ ma na frikwensi nke 2.4Ghz na nke 5.0Ghz.
translations.hypothesis: มาตรฐาน 802.11n פועל הן על תדר 2.4GHz וגם על תדר 5.0GHz.

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Nke a ga-enye ya ohere ka dịrị na ndakọta nlaghachi azụ na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, ma ọ bụrụhaala na isi ebe ahụ ụgbọigwe na-anọ nwere redìò abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: આ, позволит לו להיות সামঞ্জস্যशील עם 802.11a, 802.11b และ 802.11g, εφόσον σταasiunฐาน διαθέτει δύο συσκευές ραδιο.

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Na 802.11n, ọsịsọ ya ji nnukwu ihe kara nke ndị bu ya ụzọ; ya mere, ọrụ ọ na-arụpụta ga-eru 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: سرعات 802.11n छुआมากยิ่งกว่า سرعاتรุ่นก่อน, ؤ نا معอัตราการส่งข้อมูล สูงสุด 600Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: Duval, bụ onye lụgoro nwanyị ma mụta ụmụ abụọ bụgoro okenye, a hapụghịrị Mila onyere akọọrọ akụkọ nnukwu ihe nlere anya.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, ؤ چې הוא wedi ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ, לא ἔκανε ἔνوط प्रभाव ؤ Miller, ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ ؤ.

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Mgbe a sị ya kwuo okwu gbasara ihe mere, Mila kwuru, "Mike na-ekwu ọtụtụ okwu mgbe a na-eme ọnụnụ ahụ...anọ m na-akwado ya mere na anụghị m ihe ọ na-ekwu."
translations.hypothesis: عندماถูกถาม, ميلر قال: "مايكพูดมาก בזמןการ سماعت...હુંกำลังเตรียมตัว, તેથી હું ખરેખરไม่ได้ฟังสิ่งที่เขา говорил."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: Anyị ga-agba mbọ belata ikuku kabon dioxide kwa nke Mkpokọta ihe nrụpụta obodo site na oke 2020 site n'ọkwa 2005, Hu kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: "අපි අපේ අරමුණ වන්නේ, 2020 වන විට, අප්‍රමාණයෙන්, GDP මගින් පිටවන කාබන් ඩියօක්ሳይඩ් මට්ටම අඩු කිරීමට හැකි සෑමවිටම උත්සාහ ගන්නා බව, Hu පැවසීය।

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: O kwughi oke a ga-akwụ, kama ọ sị na a ga-ele anya na nrụpụta akụ na ụba China wee kwụọ ụgwọ.
translations.hypothesis: அவர் எந்த தொகையை削減 செய்ய வேண்டும் என்று குறிப்பிடவில்லை, மாறாக, சீனாவின் பொருளாதார உற்பத்தி அடிப்படையில்削減 θα γίνει என்று கூறினார்.

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.reference: Hu gbara obodo ndị na emepe emepe ume "ka ha ghara itinye aka n'usoro omume mgbe ochie bụ ibu ụzọ metọọ were kpochawa ma emechaa."
translations.hypothesis: Hu ਨੇদেশ ndị نا، "להיجنب ụzọ ndị bụrụ ụzọ dị ọ्हा, nke bụ ịrụ ụzọ ndị dị ọ्हा, wee mụta ịrụ ụzọ ndị dị ọ्हा."

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Ọ fọrọ obere ka mkpesa ahụ kwuo okwu ofụma gbasara akụkụ nile nke iwu ndị isi n'ebe mba Aịrak nọ ma ọ na-akwado mgbanwe ụzọ ozigbo ozigbo.
translations.hypothesis: דוక్యメント данụ nke ọ dị, ناị tụrụ ụ dị mkpa na ọ bụrụ ụ dị ọnọ nke ndịịụ bụ ụ dị ọnọ, na ọ na-achọ ụ dị mkpa.

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Nke izizi n'ime nkwado iri asaa na asatọ ya bụ na a ga-eso usoro ọchịchị ọhụrụ tupu ọgwụgwụ afọ ị hụ na echebere oke ala Aịrak megide ndị ọchọ okwu ma wughachikwa mmekọrịta ọchịchị ha na agbataobi ha.

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Onye omeiwu nakwa nwunye onyeisiala mba Argentina bụ Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner mara ọkwa na mgbede ụnyahụ na La Plata, obodo nọpụrụ kilomita 50 (maịlụ 31)site na Buenos Aires na ọ ga-eso zọọ ọkwa onyeisiala mba Argentina.
translations.hypothesis: سناتอร์ தற்போதைய, మరియు арजेન્ટिना முதல் திருமাতা, క్రిस्टينا ஃபெர்மান্দেজ డి కిर्चर, నిన్న вечером, ला பிளாटा, เมือง जो 50 કિલોமீటర్ (31 মাইল) दूर, బ्यूनোস Aires నుండి, իր προεδražական кандидатурыని அறிவிച്ചു.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ n'Ajentaịn Tiyeta ka Lọọlọ Kirchner kwuputara ebumnuche ya ịzọ maka ọkwa onye isi ala, otu ebe ahụ ọ ji bido kampen ya maka ọkwa Sịnetọ na 2005 dịka onye otu nke ndị mpaghara Buenos Aires zigara.
translations.hypothesis: Ịmụrụ Kirchnerประกาศความตั้งใจ ịchọọ ụsọ, nke dị na ụsụ Argentine, ọnọọ dị ka e mere n'oge mbụ, mgbaga ọ na-achọ ịrụ ọrụ dị ka onye membara delegation nke probinsi Buenos Aires.

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Ọ bụ esemokwu maka mmefu ego na nkwado na nrụgharị e mere mgbe Oke ikuku Katrina gasịrị kpatara arụmụka a; ụfọdụ ndị kweere na iji nwayọ emefụ ego steeti akọwaala mmefụ a n'ụzọ ntọrọmọchị dịka "Nkwekọrịta Niu Ọlịns nke Bush mere".

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: Etinyere ọtụtụ nnukwu igwe onyonyo n'ọtụtụ ebe na Rom, ka ndị mmadụ nwee ike kirie mmemme ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: หลายหน้าจอโทรทัศน์ขนาดใหญ่ถูก സ്ഥാപিত במหลาย מקומותใน רוమ్, כדיให้ประชาชนสามารถดูพิธีนั้น.

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: N'ọtụtụ obodo Itali ndị ọzọ ma na uwa nile, ọkachasị na Poland, emere nkwazi dị ka ibe ya, nke ọtụtụ mmadụ hụrụ.
translations.hypothesis: لەหลาย עירەکانی איத்தالیە, وەلە ụwa, bi dị ka Poland, ẹduk ndị dị iriri, nke ndị ọtụtụ ịchụụ.

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Ndị akụkọala akọtọla ụmụ iwuikikere FBI ndị gara aga maka ịgbado anya akụrụngwa n’ụmụ okwu ndị dị mfe ikpezi, tụmadị ụmụ okwu ụgbọ ala ezuru ezuru, n’iji ebumnobi nke ịkwalite nsìàga ọganihu ha.
translations.hypothesis: นักประวัติศาสตร์ได้วิพากษ์วิจารณ์นโยบายเก่าของ FBI สำหรับการมุ่งเน้นทรัพยากรไปยังคดีที่ง่ายต่อการแก้ไข, โดยเฉพาะอย่างยิ่งคดีรถที่ถูกขโมย, โดยมีเป้าหมายเพื่อเพิ่มอัตราความสำเร็จของหน่วยงานนั้น.

translations.source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.reference: Nzukọ omeiwu bidoro ikwado nnyocha ihe ndị dị aṅaa na fiskal n'afọ 2005 ma kwukwaa kpọmkwem na ngalaba FBI ga ewepụtarịrị ndị ozi iri maka ihe ngosi na-akpali agụụ mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị.
translations.hypothesis: مجلسได้เริ่มให้ நிதியுதุนให้กับโครงการ הפצת חומרים לאเหมาะสม בשנת הכספים 2005, וגםระบุว่า FBI צריכה להקדיש 10 סוכים לפרובוקציה של בוגרים.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa nwetara akara kachasị na innings, ọsọ 70 n’ime naanị ụmụ bọọlụ 41 site n’ịkụ anọ ugboro 11 na isii ugboro 2.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa ṣe ihe kacha dị, 70 run, na naanị 41 abụ, site na ịjụ 11 run na 2 six.

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: Ndị na-eji batị akụ n'usoro etiti, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid rụrụ ọrụ nke ọma ma mee otu nrụkọọrụ nke ọsọ-otu narị.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Mana, mgbe ha dara wicket India naanị mere 36 gbara ọ tọpụ wicket 7 iji kwụsị innings.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام، אַफ्터 ลូﺱ ৱִי케ଟ ઑଫ 캐પ્ᄐﯿﻦ, Იﻧﺪﯾﺎ ﻧﯿﺴﯽ 36 ﺭﻭﻥ, ﻭ ﻟូﺱ 7 ﻭԻ케ଟ ﺩﺍ ﻧﺪ ﮐﯽ ﺇﻧﻨିᆼ।

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: U.S. Onye isi oche Jiọj W. Bush batata Singapọ n'ụtụtụ ụbọchị nke iri na isii nke ọnwa Nọvemba, iji malite njem njegharị mba Eshia nke ga-anọzu otu izuụka.

translations.source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.reference: Onye isi oche Stivin Hapa ekwetala iziga iwu ọhụrụ nke ikuku ọcha nke gọọmenti ebe a ga elebara ya anya, tupu nleba anya nke abụọ, ma emechaa nzukọ ga-ewe ya na onye isi NDP bụ Jak Leeton nkeji iri abụọ na ise n'ụbọchị Tuzde na PMO.
translations.hypothesis: ראש ממשלה, ஸ்டيفেন ஹார்பರ್, तिने सहमति दिने की ממשलतका 'Clean Air Act' ले जाए, כדי तिमụ समीक्षा, पहिले तिमụ दुवाอ่าน, नापụ Tuesday nke 25 मिनेट बैठक dị ka ראש ממשלה, Jack Layton,ผู้นำ NDP.

translations.source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.reference: Layton arịọla maka mgbanwe nye akwụkwọ iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị mgbe ya na PM nwere nnọkọ, na-arịọ maka "ndezigharị zuru oke nke zuru ezu" nke iwu gburugburu ebe obibi nke ndị otu ọdịkaọgadị
translations.hypothesis: Layton ने ראש ממשלתי, במהלך פגישה, בקשה לגבי שינויים בצעกฎหมาย של הליגה הלאומית בנושא סביבה, ובקשה "לכתוב מחדש באופן מקיף ושלם" את הצעกฎหมาย של הליגה הלאומית.

translations.source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.reference: Kemgbe gọọmenti weere ọnọdụ ịkwụ ụgwọ ụlọ ọgwụ Mersey na Devọnpọt, Tasmania, gọọmenti steeti na ụfọdụ ndị ome iwu gọọmenti etiti ekwuola okwu megide omume a sị na ọ bụ mere mere n'ihu maka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti na-abịa na Nọvemba.
translations.hypothesis: ตั้ంแต่วันที่ ממשלת הפדרेशनเข้ามาจัดการกับการให้ทุนโรงพยาบาล Mersey ใน Devonport, Tasmania, ממשלתรัฐและบาง สมาชิกสภา הפדרेशनได้วิพากษ์วิจารณ์การกระทำนี้ כการกระทำที่ไม่เหมาะสม, לפניการเลือกตั้ง הפדרัลที่จะเกิดขึ้นในเดือน נובמבר.

translations.source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.reference: Mana Prime Minista John Howard ekwuola na ihe a mere bụ naanị ka ichebe ụmụ akụrụngwa nke ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ site n'aka mwedàta siri n'aka gọọmentị Tasmania, n'inye mmezi nke nde AUD$45.
translations.hypothesis: কিন্তু ראש ממשלתי, ג'ון הווארד, אמרว่า פעולה זו נועדה כדי להגן על מתקנים של בית חולים מפני הורדת רמתם על ידי ממשלת טאסמניה, כאשר הם מקבלים תוספת של 45 מיליון דולר אוסטרלי.

translations.source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

translations.hypothesis: השמי, nke nke عشر במספר, "Subtropical Storm Jerry", ৱụrụ ịnụ Atlantic Ocean Ụbọ.

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ Etiti na-ahụ maka Ajọ ifufe (NHC) kwuru sị n’oge a Jeri abụghị ihe iyi egwu nye ala.
translations.hypothesis: מרכז הטורนาडो הלאומי (NHC) אומרว่า בזマン הזה, ג'েরি אינו מהווה איום על קרק.

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: Ward Itoolu, nke hụrụ oke ide mmiri ruru ihe dị ka feet iri abụọ n'oge Ajọ Ifufe Katrina, nọ na nnukwu mmiri na eru ukwu ma gafere akwa levee nọ nso.
translations.hypothesis: Ụkwụ nke nkeji, bụ nke ראהน้ำท่วมสูงถึง 20 ฟุต בזמןพายุ Katrina, ปัจจุบัน נמצא במياهระดับเข่า เนื่องจากกำแพงกันน้ำรอบๆ ถูกน้ำท่วม.

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Mmiri n’aghafu n’otu akuku levee obodobo ya di 100feet.
translations.hypothesis: ماءกำลังไหลเบี่ยงออกจาก הגשר במקטעที่มี عرض 100ฟุต.

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Onye nchikwa commons Adam Cuerden gosiputara iwe ya  n’elu ihe eghichapuru mgbe ogwara Wikinews okwu n’onwa gara gara.
translations.hypothesis: ຜູ້บริหาร מערכת Κοמוन्स, آدم เคర్ডেন, వ్యక్తీకరించిన súaความ разочарование గురించిన తొలగింపులు, នៅពេលเขา דוברกับ Wikinews ғана เดือนที่แล้ว.

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: O (Wales) n’ezie turu anyi asi site na mbido. Mbu, site na ikpa-agwa ka ihe a bu okwu iwu, Nke abuo, site na igho-aghugho na ona ege anyi nti, ruori mgbe ehichapuru nka ya.
translations.hypothesis: "அவர் [வேல்ஸ்] ஆரம்பத்தில், அடிப்படையில், எங்களுக்கு பொய் கூறினார். முதலாவதாக, இது சட்டரீதியான காரணங்களுக்காக என்பதை போல நடந்துகொண்டார். இரண்டாவதாக, அவர் எங்களை கேட்கிறார் என்று போல காட்டிக்கொண்டார், அதுவரை அவரது கலைப் படைப்புகளை அழித்தார்."

translations.source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.reference: Mkpadu iwe obodo butere maka mgbali ide iwu gbasara ihe ngosi mmekọahụ na webụsaịtị na-egosi ọtụtụ ihe.
translations.hypothesis: ความโกรธของชุมชนนำไปสู่ความพยายาม הנוכwärtนี้ในการร่างนโยบาย בנוגעเนื้อหาทางเพศสำหรับ אתר האינטרเน็ต ซึ่งมีสื่อมากมายที่มีใบอนุญาตเปิด

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Ọrụ arụrụ bụkarịrị nke iwu a ka na enyocha enyocha, mana edere usoro omume ihe ahụ ka o gosipụta ihe ahụtara ụyọkọ kpakpando Sajiterius.
translations.hypothesis: الشغل nke נע, هو בעיקר सैद्धांतিক, কিন্তু البرنامج كتب لكي يمثل الملاحظات التي تم جمعها عن مجرة سجزيتاريوس.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.reference: Mmetụta otu ahụ nọ na-achọ ga-esite n'aka ikikere taịdị ndị dị n'etiti mata ojii nke galaxy na mata ojii nke Milky Way.
translations.hypothesis: הผลลัพธ์ چې אירועەکەเกือบจะ, دەبوون ناتەند, دەبوون ב कारण כוח גאות-غروب בינָאר בין חומר שחור لە גלקסי আৰু חומר שחור لە Milky Way.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị ọrịa enweela ike ibute ọrịa ahụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ, Dr. Moll cheere, ma ihe dị ka abụọ bụ ndị ọrụ ụlọ ọgwụ.
translations.hypothesis: بە mõतە, بىر قانەن రోగుৱা دەتوانێت зараৱ لە نەستى، דکتەر مول فکر কৰে، আৰু कम देखै, दुई जना हुन् जो نەستىৰ कर्मचारीहरू।

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Na otu afo n’abia abia, onye butara nje nwere ibunye ya mmadu 10 ruo 15 n’eru ya nso.
translations.hypothesis: cikin 12 חודש, אדם נגועสามารถ להדבק 10 עד 15 איש קרובים.

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị, pacentị nke XDR-TB nọ n’ime òtù niile nke ndị nwere ụkwara nta ka yiri ka ọ dị obere; 6,000 nke mpokọta ndị mmadụ 330,000 nwetere ọrịa ahụ n’oge ọ bụla n’ime South Afrịka.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام، אחוৱা nke XDR-TB لەگەڵ هەموو کەسانەی كە هەنجە لە דרום ئەفریقا، ئەوەدووە كە ئەوە زۆر کەمە؛ 6,000 لە 330,000 کەس كە هەنجە لە هەرکاتێکیش لە دרום ئەفریقا.

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Satịlaịtị ndị ahụ, abụọ nke na-anyị arụ karịa nke gafere paụnd 1,000, ma na-ekwo ọsọ n’ọdịka maịlị kwa awa 17,500, sukọrọ ọnụ maịlị 491 n’elu Eluụwa.
translations.hypothesis: לוثات, ఇทั้งคู่, چې משקל שלהם עולה על 1,000 פاؤنڈ, ונע במהירות כ-17,500 מייל לשעה, התנגש באתר 491 מייل מעל פני כדור הארץ.

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị sị na mgbasa nkụkọta isi ahụ butere dị ukwu.

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Ha ka na anwale ịchọpụta etu ibu mkpọka ahụ dị ma etu ọ ga-esi emetụta Uwa.
translations.hypothesis: wọnยังคงพยายามหาคำตอบว่าอุบัติเหตุนั้นใหญ่แค่ไหน และ איך כדורโลกจะได้รับผลกระทบ

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: United States Strategic Command nke ụlọ ọrụ Ngalaba Nchebe U.S. na-esochi irighiri ihe ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: צו הפעולה האסטרטيجي של الولايات المتحدة، التابع لمكتب الدفاع،กำลังติดตามเศษซาก.

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: A ga-ezìga ozī nyocha nke nkata akpara n'otu weebụsaịtị ọha.
translations.hypothesis: ফলাফল של ניתוक จะถูกโพสต์ באתרสาธารณะ.

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Otu dibia-bekee onye rubuuru oru ulo-ogwu umuaka nke pittsburgh, Pennysylvania ka aga ekpe ikpe banyere igbu-mmadu nke akpasuru-iwe ka ahuchara nne ya na azu ugbo-ala na-onwu n’ubochi Wednesde, ka ndi isi no na Ohio kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: একজন डॉक्टर, जो ב Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, లో Children's Hospital मा काम गरे, ले अभियोग लगाइन्छ, पछि आफ्नो אמא Wednesday आफ्नो कार मा मृत अवस्थामा भेटिएको, अनुसार Ohio autorités।

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.reference: Ahuru Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, na Blue Ash, Ohio otu sobob di nso 15 miles n’ebe ugwu Cincinnati ka o dine n’ala n’akuku okporouzo naani ihe oyi bu tshirt na uwe ime, otu osi noro gosiri na ono n’okpuru ike ogwu.
translations.hypothesis: دکتر مالارบาลاسوبرامانيان، בן 29،เกือบถูกพบใน بلوا أ্যাশ، أوهيو، وهي منطقةใกล้กับ سينسيناتي, ซึ่งอยู่ประมาณ 15 מייล์ทางเหนือ, ונמצא עלพื้นถนน, ใส่เสื้อ טי และ בגדים פנימי, ונראהว่า הוא נמצא במצבที่ได้รับยามาก.

translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Ọ dụrụ ndị ọrụ nche gaa na Oldsmobile Intrigue ojii ya nke nọ n’ụzọukwu narị ise n’itoanya.
translations.hypothesis: ఆమె ఆదేశించింది పోలీసులనుไปยัง ఆమె నల్ల Oldsmobile Intrigue, ఇది 500 అడుగు దూరంలో ఉంది.

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: Achọtara ozu Saroja Balasubramanian, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, ebe ahụ, ja akwa mkpuchi kpudoro ya.
translations.hypothesis: त्यहाँ, wọn מצאו גוף של סاروጃ बालासुברامانیאן, בן 53, ܟܠܗ ܟܠదో, ܟܠܗ ܟܠదో.

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii kwuru na ahụ ahụ dị ka ọ nọọla ebe ahụ ruo ihe dị ka otu ụbọchị.
translations.hypothesis: ndị polis na-sị na ẹhịa ahụ dị ka ọ dị ebe fyrir kọ, kọ ụfọdụ.

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: Okwu mbu ndị ahụ nke ọrịa ahụ n'oge a bụ ka a kọrọ n'ime ebe ọgwụgwụ May.
translations.hypothesis: أول حالة الأمراض في هذا الموسم تم الإبلاغ عنها في أواخر شهر تموز.

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Ezi na ebu ọrịa ahụ, nke anwụnta na ebunyezi ndị mmadụ.
translations.hypothesis: રોગەکەแพร่ καৰা, کە त्यसपछिแพร่ καৰા بۆ మనుషులు דרך דัก។

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Ihe ndaputa a emela ka goomenti mba India bido mebe ihe dika izipu ndi na ejide ezi na mpaghara ometuru hinne, ikesa akwa mgbochi anwu nta makwa igba ogwu na-egbu pesti.
translations.hypothesis: આ રોગได้กระตุ้น ממשלת ભારત לקחת પગલાંต่างๆ, जसेว่า העברת אנשים שמ収集 خنزير في المناطق الأكثر تضرر، توزيع آلاف من ستائر الحشرات، و رش مبيدات.

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ensefalitis dị nde kwuru nde ka gọọmenti kwere na nkwa, nke ga-akwado ndị ọrụ ahụike maka afọ na-abịa abịa.
translations.hypothesis: همچنین، ממשלת Nigeriaก็ได้สัญญาถึง מאות אלף הזجاجات של لقاح ضد مرض एन्सेفलाइटिस، والتي ستساعد الوكالات الصحية להתכונן לקראת השנה القادمة.

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: N'afọ 1956 Słania gara Swiden, ebe afọ atọ gasịrị o bidoro ịrụ ọrụ na ụlọ ọrụ nzipu ozi nke Swiden ma bụrụkwa onye isi mbinye.
translations.hypothesis: N'afọ 1956, Słania lọta Sweden, nde ọ bụrụ nke, afọ 3 ka ọ tụrụ ọrụ na Ofis Post Sweden, ọnụọdụ ọ bụ ndị na-ahụ maka ịkpụ ụzọ.

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: O mepụtaara stampụ karịrị 1,000 maka Swidin na mba 28 ndị ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: அவர் ஸ்வீடன் மற்றும் 28 பிற நாடுகளுக்கு 1,000க்கும் மேற்பட்ட ஸ்டாம்ப் произвел.

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Oru ya bunke amaara nke oma na iti igba ma doo kwa anya nke oma na obu otu nime ndi amaara n’ezinulo nile na ndi philatelist. Ufodu lekwasiri anya nnoo na ichikota oru ya nani.
translations.hypothesis: الأعمال שלו تتميز بجودة و تفاصيل التي تجعلها مشهور، لذلك هو واحد من عدد قليل جدًا من "أسماء مشهور" في مجال جمع الطوابع. بعضบุคคล يركزون فقط على جمع أعماله.

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Stampụ ya nke otu puku bụ “Nnukwu Omume nke Ndị Eze Sweden” ahụ dị ebube nke David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl dere na 2000, nke edepụtara na Akwụkwọ Guiness nke Ndekọ Ụwa.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: O sokwa na aru ego akwukwo mba di iche iche, otu oru oruru ohuru bu foto Onye isi goomenti Canada etinyeru n’ihu ego ohuru $5 na $100 ndi Canada.
translations.hypothesis: তদিয়ে, Ọ bụrụوە ẹnọ, Ọ dị ụtọ ịrụ ọrụ ịგụ ndị naira dị iche iche, ụdị ọrụ ọ bụ, dị ka ihe ndị dị iche na-agụ na ndị naira Canadian 5 na 100 ọrụ ọ bụ.

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Mgbe ihe mberde ahụ mechara, e buru Gibson gawa n’ụlọ ọgwụ mana ọ nwụrụ mgbe obere oge gachara.
translations.hypothesis: ຫລัຈາກอุบัติเหตุ, ﺟԻﺑﺴﻦ ຖືກ ਲਿਆ ໄປ ໂຮ스πιታል, কিন্তু ﻓﻘﻂ ﻓﻲ ﻓﺮ ﺟﺪ, ᱩᱱᱩਨ ﻓﺎد।

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ gwongworo ahụ, nke gbara afọ 64, emerụghị ahụ na mkpọka ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: चालক ट्रक, ຜູ້ ambayo ਉਮରି 64, איन्جৰੀ, איन्جৰี

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: N'otu ụbọchị ahụ, ebe elekere nke iri na abụọwepụrụ ụgbọ ahụ n'ebe ihe mbere mere.
translations.hypothesis: خودรถนั้นถูกนำออก khỏi מקום ава accident בסביבות 12:00 นาทา GMT, באותו יום.

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Otu onye na-arụ ọrụ ebe a na-adọba ụgbọala nọ n’akụkụ ebe ihe mberede ahụ mere kwuru si: "E nwere ụmụaka nọ na-eche ịgafe okporo ụzọ ahụ nakwa ha nille nọ na-eti mkpu ma na-ebe akwa."
translations.hypothesis: એક వ్యక్తి જે работал в гараж рядом где авария произошла сказал: "હناك બાળકો જેรอતા હતા જેથી તેઓ રસ્તો પાર કરી શકે, અને તેઓ બધા ચીસો કાઢી અને રડતા હતા."

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.reference: Ihe ndi ozo akpara na Bali bu izoputa ohia ndi ozo di n’uwa na ikee nka n’uzu nwere ike inyere ndi mba n’ebilite aka itoo n’uzo ga-akwusi mmeto ikuku.
translations.hypothesis: यी বিষয় ndị ناอื่นในวาระการประชุม בبالي כולל הגנה על rừngים העיקריים של העולם, וגם שיתוף טכנולוגיות כדי לסاعد מדינות המתפתן לצמיחה بطرق שאינן פוגع البيئة.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: Ndi U.N. nwekwara olileanya iwepụta ego iji nyere mba niile aka ndị global wọmịn metụtara iji nagide nsogbu o butere.
translations.hypothesis: جامعة الأمم المتحدة, ؤ أيضاً, надеется завершить создание фонда, который поможет کشورهایی, چېได้รับผลกระทบจาก изменение האקلیم, כדי להתמודد עם ההשלכות.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Enwere ike iji ego agụ rụọ ụlọ ndị mmiri anaghi ebu, njikwa dọtị ka mma, na ọkụkụ ihe dị iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: أموال هؤلاء يمكن أن تُستخدم لبناء مساكن المقاومة للفيضان، إدارة المياه بشكل أفضل، و تنويع زراعة.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: Fluke dere na mbo ufodu gbara ihu na emechiri onu umunwanyi iji kwusi ha ikwuputa okwu maka ihe gbasara ahuike umu nwanyi agaghi nkeoma.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Ndị otu mgbanyụ ọkụ mechara gbanyụọ ọkụ ahụ ebe 11:35 nke abalị.
translations.hypothesis: צוות ndị dị ụkwụ ụkwụ בערך ṣe ụkwụ ọ bụrụ ụkwụ 11:35pm.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Mgbe aruchara akwa-mmiri ahu na afo 1963, ewee kwusi udu idemiri ahu nke na agbasa unyi na ahu mmiri ahu nile.
translations.hypothesis: بعد أن السدถูกสร้าง בשנת 1963، الفيضانات העमौمي التي كانت تسببการแพร่กระจายของดินในแม่น้ำถูกหยุด.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Sedimenti a dị mkpa maka ịmepụta ụmụ mgbochi ejiri aja mee ma akụkụ osimiri, nke jere ozi dị ka ebe obibi anụ ọhịa.
translations.hypothesis: wannan ƙasa ne, wanda ana amfani da shi don ƙirƙirar ƙasa da ɓaramin, wanda ya kasance gidajin da zaune da rayuwa.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: N’ihi nke ahụ, ụdị azụ abụọ ekpochapụla, ma abụọ ndị ọzọ abụrụla ndị nọ n’ihe ize ndụ, gụnyere humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: بەผลสืบเนื่อง, שתי סוג של माవి نا गयो, আৰু אַन्नि, รวมถึง chubที่มีลักษณะเฉพาะ, نا गयो.

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghi na larịị mmiri ahụ ga-eto elu ụkwụ ole na ole naanị mgbe idei mmiri ahụ gasịrị, ndị isi na-enwe olile anya na ọ ga-ezu iji weghachi ụmụ ugwu aja nke mmiri riri na ndịda ụzọ mmiri.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام, ระดับนำ้ भनेకాך भनेకాך יرتفع פাৰێ، بەڵام די איבער, ئەوان ناڕە، ئەوە دەبێتە ھۆی بازگردانەوە دەمە کە ھەیە لە نزیک.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.

translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ enyemaka ahụike Mangola, 'Medecines Sans Frontieres', na Wọld Helt Ọganaịzeshọn na-ekwụ na ọ bụ ntiwapụ ọrịa kachasị njọ ahụrụla na mba ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: সংস্থা медицинская, Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres, һәм World Health Organisation, भन्छन् भने यस हो иң खराब प्रकोप যিเคยrecorded হৈছে ኣብ देशەکە.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Onye nkwuchite maka Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman kwuru: "Angola na-agaru maka ntiwapụ ya kacha njọ mgbe ọ bụla ma ọnọdụ ahụ ka dịkwa njọ n’ime Angola,” o kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: អ្នកสื่อข่าวของ Medecines Sans Frontiere, Richard Veerman, भने: "Angola กำลังเผชิญกับสถานการณ์แย่ที่สุดเท่าที่เคยมีมา, และสถานการณ์ยังคงแย่มากใน Angola," הואกล่าว.

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu ji ihu igwe dị mma bido ebe elekere iri nke ụtụtụ, ewepụ igirigi yọrọ n'ụtụtụ nke gbachara ọsịsọ, ọ bụ ụbọchị zuru oke nye 7's rugbi.
translations.hypothesis: الألعاب بدأت في الساعة 10:00 صباحًا مع طقس جيد، و بخلاف المطر الخفيف في منتصف الصباح، الذي اختفى بسرعة، كان هذا يوم مثالي للعبة رغبي 7.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: Ndi kachasị elu na asọmpi bu South Africa bidoro na akara nke oma mgbe ha nwere mmeri ntụsara ahụ nke 26 - 00 megide Zambia gbara mkpụrụ nke 5.
translations.hypothesis: Mannschaft העילית, דרום אפריקה, התחיל בצורה טובה כאשר הם השיגו ניצחון נוח 26 - 00 נגד צוות העילית החמישי, זמビア.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Ụzọ niile dị n'ọgba ahụ a kpọrọ “Ụmụnne nwanyị asaa” dị ihe dịka opekatampe 100 mita ruo mita 250 (fiiti 328 ruo 820) na dayamita.
translations.hypothesis: બધી פתח הסלע, چې קոչられました "שבע אחיות", הן לפחות 100 עד 250 מטר (328 עד 820 רגל) במעגל.

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Ụmụ onyinyo infràreèd na-egosipụta na mgbanwe okpomọkụ ahụ sitere n'ụbọchị na abalị na-egosi na ha nwere ike ịbụ ọgba.
translations.hypothesis: รูปภาพ אינफ्रارედ δείχνουν ότι οι διαφορές θερμοκραția ביןည ​​و ημέρα δείχνουν أن هؤلاء הם כנראהถ้ำ.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: Ha na-adị oyi karịa gburugburu ha n'ehihie ma dị ọkụ karịa n'abalị.
translations.hypothesis: "அவை பகலில், ஒட்டுமொத்த மேற்பரப்பைக் காட்டிலும் குளிர்ந்த, மற்றும் இரவில் சூடாக இருக்கும்."

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Omume okpomọkụ ha anaghị adịgide ka nnukwu ọgba dị n'ụwa nke na-enwe okpomọkụ na-anaghị agbanwe, mana ọ dị ka ndị a maka na ha bụkwa olulu miri emi n'ime ala," Glen Cushing kwuru, onye United States Geology Survey (USGS) Otu Astrojiọlọji na nke Mahadum Northern Arizona dị na Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: พฤติกรรม התחום שלה אינו స్థిรเท่ากับถ้ำขนาดใหญ่บนโลก ซึ่งมักจะรักษาระดับอุณหภูมิที่ค่อนข้างคงที่, แต่เป็นไปตามว่านี่คือหลุมลึกในดิน," אמרו Glen Cushing จากสำนักงานสำรวจทางธรณีวิทยาของสหรัฐอเมริกา (USGS) และทีมแอตโรจีโอโลยี, รวมถึงมหาวิทยาลัยนอร์เทิร์น อ্যারิโซนา, שנמצאใน Flagstaff, อ্যারิโซนา.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: Na mba Frans, ịtụ ụtụ bụ ihe anaghị eji ike eme: ndị na-atụ ụtụ na ewezuga onwe ha n'otu ụlọ ndo, tinye akwụkwọ ebiri na ndịnihu nke na-egosi onye ha na atụrụ ụtụ n'ime akwụkwọ amachiri amachi.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Ka ndị nchịkọta nyochachara onye na-atụ ụtụ, onye na-atụ ụtụ etinye akwụkwọ ụtụ ya amachiri amachi n'ime igbe nnakọ ụtụ ma bie aka n'akwụkwọ ndị tụrụ ụtụ.
translations.hypothesis: ৰাহাবাহাৰ, ئەফিসিয়ালहरूले পৰিவịৰ ভোটৰ şəৰ்த, ভোটৰ şəৰ்தকৰाहাবাহাৰले دەৱে আৰু دەৱেৰ ৰোলमा கையெழுத்து।

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Kemgbe 1988, ụmụ igbe ntuli aka ga-abụrịrị ngafe-ahụ-ụzọ ka ndị ntụli aka na ndị nnyota ga-agba akaebe na o nweghị envelopu nọ na ya mgbe a na-ebido ntuli aka nakwa o nweghị envelopu etinyere ewezụga nke ndị agụgwere ọnụ ma nye ikikere nke ọma.
translations.hypothesis: ตั้ం 1988, กล่อง הצوți πρέπει ىكون पारदर्शी, כדי چې ناาาและผู้สังเกตสามารถเห็นว่า אין ใด envelopes ىكون ىตอนเริ่มต้นการลงคะแนน, และไม่มี envelopes ใดถูกเพิ่ม ยกเว้น envelopes ىของผู้ลงคะแนนที่ได้รับการนับและอนุมัติ

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.

translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, چې פעםถูก அறிமுகப்படுத்த بۆ צוৱา আৰু פังก์ชัน, הפך לविष مهم אין חודש טెక్นิโולוגي 2007 ٽାଇبي،

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.

translations.hypothesis: কিন্তু, سوق వినియోగదారులు барои קומپیوटर ल्याפּటాప్, կը կը փոխվի եւ կը կը սկսի ըլլը տարբեր, אַֆթər ASUS կը ստանայ 2007 թվականի Թայवानի ոլորսական մրցանակէն, ըստ Executive Yuan ըստ ազգային Չինաստանի.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: Otu onye nkere anya kọwapụtara Bishkek dịka ihe na-emikpu n'ọnọdụ "ọgba aghara", ka ndị mmadụ na akpagharị na eburughara ngwa ahịa n'ike.
translations.hypothesis: Bishkekถูกอธิบายว่าเป็น "حکومت כאוס" โดยผู้สังเกตการณ์คนหนึ่ง, כאשרกลุ่มคนเดินตามถนนและขโมยสินค้า צרכיםจากร้านค้า.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Otutu ndi bi na Bishkek tara ndi na-eme ngaghari iwe si na odida anyanwu uta gbasara imebi iwu
translations.hypothesis: ઘણાवासीชาว Bishkek обвинили протестующих из южной части за отсутствие نظم.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: Mba Sawụtụ Afrịka emeriela Ọl Bụlaksị (Nuu Ziilandị) n'egwuregwu rọgụbi nke Mbanaatọ n'ama egwuregwu Royal Bafokeng nke dị na Rọstenbọgụ, Sawụtụ Afrịka.
translations.hypothesis: दक्षिण ஆப்பிரிக்கได้เอาชนะ الفريق "All Blacks" (نيوزيلندا) في مباراة اتحاد رغبي Tri Nations في ملعب Royal Bafokeng في رستنبرغ، جنوب أفريقيا.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: N'ikpeazụ, otu ọkpụ ka ha jiri merie ha, ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ na otu ebe ndị mmegide ha sara ọkpụ iri abụọ. Nke a usoro mmeri iri na ise ndị Ọl Blaks na mmechi.
translations.hypothesis: תוצאה הסופית waxay bụ 21-20, ẹnọchukwu nke All Blacks na 15 trận, nke na-amalị ihe.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: Maka òtù Springboks ndị ahụ, ọ kwụsịrị na egwuregwu-ise nke ogologo usoro ọdịda.
translations.hypothesis: بە بۆคส์, ئەوە waxay דווקא סમેટ咗 סەرێکی חמישה משחקים.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ ịsọmpi ikpeazụ nke Ọl Blaks ndị merigoro ihe nnweta izu ụka abụọ gara aga.

translations.reference: A ga-agba egwuregwu ikpeazụ nke ogbe a n'Elis Pak na Johanesbọg n'izu na-abịa abịa, mgbe ndị Sprịngbọks ga-agba Ọstrelia.

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.

translations.hypothesis: زلزالەکە דווקא لە نزیک Dillon، בערך 20 קิโลమీט (15 מייل) צפון- കിמי ڕۆح، আৰু בערך 65 קิโลమీט (40 מייل) דרום Butte.

translations.hypothesis: Chambers, ຜູ້ທີ່ບໍ່ເຊື່ອ, ඊ້ນว่า ਦਾవాຂອງ ਉਸ "ບໍ່ມີความสำคัญ" আৰু "ໝarının ໃຜ ڀອຍ ໃຜ".

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Akụkọ egosipụtara na opera french, nke Camille Saint-Saens dere, bụ maka onye na-ese ihe "nke ịhụnanya o nwere maka Japan na ọgwụ ike na-achị ndụ ya."
translations.hypothesis: حكاية నచ్చిన, నొక నటుడు, "కామిల్ స్టెయిన్-సానెస్, הוא ఒక కళాకారుడు, జీవితం שלו నయం మరియు జపాన్ పట్ల ప్రేమ ద్వారా నడిపించబడింది."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: N'ihi nke a ndị na-eme ihe ngosi na-ese igbo n'ebe ngosi ihe, ndị nwe ụlọ ngosi ihe na-akwadokwa ndị nlere anya ka ha sonye.
translations.hypothesis: بەผลสืบเนื่อง, אידיผู้แสดงสูบยา κάνابिस, আৰু אידי תיאٹرเองกওกำลังเชิญชวนผู้ชมให้เข้าร่วม.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Onye na-ekwubu okwu n'ụlọ omeiwu bụ Newt Gingrich, onye isi obodo Tekzas bụ Rik Perị, na onye otu nzukọ omeiwu Mishel Bakmann mechara gba ndị anọ, ise na isii, n'usoro.
translations.hypothesis: อดีต ראשสภา, ניউట్ גיङ्गريచ్, Gubernur เทক্সાસ, ריك เพرى, และ חברת קונগ্রెస్, מיเชల్ באخمマン, סิ้นสุด במอันดับ רביעי, חמישי, และ השישי, בהתאמה.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Ka akara omume pụtara, Gingrich kelere Santorum, mana ọ gwara Rọmni okwu ike, n'ihi ụdịrị mkpọsa ozi ọ kpọsara megide Gringrich na Ayowa.
translations.hypothesis: بعد أنผลลัพธ์ออกมา, Gingrichชม Santorum, แต่เขามีคำพูดที่หนักกับ Romney, ซึ่งโฆษณาแคมเปญ שליליถูกนำเสนอใน Iowa เพื่อสนับสนุน Gingrich.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry kwuru na ọ ga "agaghachị Tekzas ileba anya n'akara omume abalị a, ịchọpụta ma o nwere ọganihu n'ọsọ ahụ", ma na omechara kwuo na ọ ga anọgide n'ọsọ ma sọọ mpi izizi na Karolaina n'ụbọchị nke iri abụọ na otu nke ọnwa Jenụwarị.
translations.hypothesis: بيري заявилว่าเขา "خواهد вернуться إلى تكساس כדיประเมินผลของการประชุม הערב, כדי לקבוע אם هناك طريق આગળสำหรับผม במهمة הזאת", אך بعد ذلك הוא אמרว่าเขาจะยังคงอยู่ใน مسابقة ובالمشاركة في الانتخابات الأولية في ولاية ساوث كارولينا ב-21 มกราคม.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bakman, onye meriri Ntuliaka Ames Strọ n'Ọgọọst, kpebiri ịkwụsị kampen ya.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, ຜູ້贏ผู้โหวٽ Ames Straw Poll នា אַගస్టు, ຕົ décider ຢ່າສືບຕໍ່ແຄ້ມຂອງເธอ.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: E bugara onye ahụ na-ese fòto na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Reagan UCLA, ebe o mechara nwụọ.
translations.hypothesis: ফটোগ্রাফারถูกนำไปยัง מרכז רפואي של UCLA, تحت إشراف رونالد ريगन, حيث هوเสียชีวิต لاحقًا.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: A kọbụrụ na ọ nọ n’ime ụmụ afọiri abụọ ya. N’otu nkwupụta, Bieber siri "Agbanyeghị na ọ nọghị ma ọ sonyeghị ozugbo ọdachi ihe mberede okporo ụzọ a, echiche na ekpere m nonyere ezinụlọ ndị onye a tara ahụhụ."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Webụsaịtị akụkọ ntụrụndụ TMZ ghọtara onye na-ese fòto ahụ kwụsịrị ụgbọala ya n'akụkụ nke ọzọ nke okporo ámá Sepulveda sara mbara nwere ụmụ osisi akwụwara n'akụkụ ya ma nwaa ị see fòto nkwụsị ndị uwe ojii tupu ya agafee okporo ụzọ wee gaa n'ihu, na-akpali onye uwe ojii Njeghari ilekota Nnukwu okporo ụzọ anya nke California na-eduzi okporo ụzọ iji nyeghachi ya iwu gafeghachị , ugboro abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: ເວ็บไซต์ข่าวความบันเทิง TMZ, ڄாว่า φωτο그래ฟหยุดรถของเขาฝั่งตรงข้ามถนน Sepulveda, และพยายามถ่ายรูปตำรวจ ขณะที่เขาข้ามถนน, דברซึ่งทำให้เจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจ של California Highway Patrol, ڄாว่า กำลังทำการหยุดรถ,สั่งให้เขากลับไปอีกครั้ง, פעמיสອງ.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Dị ka ndị uwe ojii kwuru, ọkwụ ụgbọ ala ahụ suru onye na-ese fòto eleghị anya ọ gaghị enwe ebubo mpụ ọ bụla.
translations.hypothesis: Ըն حسب الشرطة، السائق של المركبة التي اصطدمت مع المصور، من غير المحتمل أن يواجه اتهامات جنائية.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Ya na naanị medaal iri na asatọ dị kwa otu ụbọchị, ọtụtụ mba adala imepụta ikpo okwu medaal ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: بەسبە ئەوەว่า ھەرڕۆژ، ھەندێک देश בלێ 18 مەدאַڵ، ئەوە ھەندێک देश نەتوانێت ەوەدە لە בەیەن مەدאַڵ.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Ha gụnyere mba Nedalands, ebe Anna Jochemsen gbara onye nke itoolu n'egwuregwu nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwanyị nke asọmpi Super-G ụnyaahụ, na Fịnland ebe Katja Saarinen gbara onye nke iri n'otu egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: આમાં περιλαμβάνουν નેदरલેન્ડ, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਏਨਾ ਜੋਖੇਮੇನ್ ਨੇ ਯESTERDAY, στην κατηγορία Super-G, κατακτήσει θέση 9, και ਫின்λανδία, ਜਿੱਥੇ ਕਾਟਜਾ ਸਾਰੀਨੇਨ ਨੇ επίσης κατακτήσει θέση 10 στην ίδια સ્પર્ધા.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Michel Gọrli gbachara Super-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke dịka onye nke iri na otu. Oldrich Jelinek, onye Chek rịpọblik gbara onye nke iri na isii na Super-G ọnụnọ ala ụmụ nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley, kutoka Australia, جاء במקוםeleventh במجموع الرجال Super-G. המתחרה التشيكي, Oldrich Jelinek, جاء במקוםสิบหก במجموع الرجال Super-G.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velaskwez, onye Megziko, gbara onye nke iri na ise na Supa-G ịnọ ọdụ nke ụmụ nwoke. Adam Họl, onye Niu Ziland, gbara onye nke itoolu na Supa-G nkwụmọtọ ụmụ nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez, kutoka Мексиको, סיร็จสิ้นอันดับสิบห้าในการแข่งขัน Super-G สำหรับผู้ชาย. Adam Hall, kutoka న్యూઝीलैंड, סיร็จสิ้นอันดับเก้าในการแข่งขัน Super-G สำหรับผู้ชาย.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Onye Poland kpuri isi bụ Maciej Krezel na-egwu egwuregwu ski, na onye ndu ya Anna Ogarzynska mechara onye nke iri na atọ na asọm mpi Supa-G. Jong Seork Park onye South Korea mechara onye nke iri abụọ na ano na asọm mpi ụmụnwoke Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: นักสกีชาวโปแลนด์, Maciej Krezel, ذوي לקות ראייה, وคู่ฝึก Anna Ogarzynska, סיים במקום الثالث عشر في مسابقة Super-G. Jong Seork Park, ذوي לקות ראייה, من كوريا الجنوبية, סיים في المركز العشرين في مسابقة Super-G للمذكرين.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: Na-ndabere n’ikpe ahụ, ehichaghị ọfụma mkpofu si na kampụ UN, nke na-akpata nje ịbanye nna nwaghara ụzọ nke osimiri Artibonite, otu n’ime nke Haịti kachasị ibu.
translations.hypothesis: بەทำัต, వ్యర్థات פ্ৰەنטי UN אינאַ נישט ניوە, کە דוৱา מאַٽাৰیا פڕ्‌เข้า cikin دەม Artibonite, کە אַదో אַదో די גరిม دەم لە Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Tupu ndị agha abịarute, Haiti ezutebeghị nsogbu ndị metụtara ọrịa ahụ kemgbe oge ndị 1800.
translations.hypothesis: ముందుగా quânలు පැමිණ ก่อน, ჰaitiले 1800వ թվականից ጀም၍, వ్యాధిंशी связанные ගැටලු չեղել.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ ikpe na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na Haiti atụjela aka n'ọmụmụ sị na ndị agha udo UN nke Nepal bubatara ọrịa na Nepal n'amaghị ama.
translations.hypothesis: สถาบันความยุติธรรมและประชาธิปไตยแห่งฮาတီได้อ้างถึง מחקרอิสระ ซึ่งชี้ให้เห็นว่าหน่วยรบรักษาความสงบของสหประชาชาติจากเนปาล ได้นำโรคนี้มาสู่ฮาတီโดยไม่รู้ตัว.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, otu onye ọkachamara UN n’ọrịa ahụ, kwuru na ntiwapụ ahụ bụ ndị na-eme ụdọ nwere ike ịkpata ya.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton kwetere na Ụlọ ọgwụ Mahadum Howard nabatara onye ọrịa ahụ n’ọnọdụ ahụ kwụsiri ike
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton تؤكد أن مستشفى جامعة הוاردได้ قبول مريضนั้น في حالة الصحية.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Onye ọrịa ahụ agabuola na Naịjirịa, ebe a na-enwela ụfọdụ ndị bu nje Ebola ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: ผู้ป่วยเคยมาไนจีเรีย, איכן случаи של ভাইรัส Ebola Ọ dị.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọgwụ ahụ esorola ìwuùsòrò maka njikwa ọrịa ofufe, gụnyere iwepụta iche onye ọrịa ahụ site na ndị ọzọ iji gbochie mbufe ndị ọzọ ọrịa nwere ike ime.
translations.hypothesis: בית החולים đãปฏิบัติตาม פרוโตקॉल למنع זיהום, כולל הפרדה של המريضจาก אחרים כדי למنع אפשরের זיהום של אחרים.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Tupu Simpsons Simon Ahụ arụọla ọrụ n’ọtụtụ ihe nkiri n’ọkwa dị iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: Zaman Simpson, Simon Ọrụ dị iche iche na Ụmụ Simpson.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: N'afọ ndị 1980, ọ rụrụ ọrụ n'ihe ngosi dị ka Tagzi, Cheers, ya na ihe ngosi Tresi Ullman.
translations.hypothesis: لە ساৰ 1980، ئەو ەیەی لە برنامەکانی وەकाوە وەका, Cheers, وە The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Na mbido izu a, helịkọpta ndị uwe ojii kpọkasịrị gbuo mmadụ atọ ma merụọ mmadụ atọ ọzọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: لەگەل سەرەتای هەفتەکە، ڕووداوێک کە هەڵەی هەڵپیرۆت پلیس، خەمێک، و لەگەل هەڵەی تەنێک، خەمێک.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: N’ọnwa gara aga Iran hụrụ ihe ọdachi ikuku ya kachasị njọ n’ọtụtụ afọ mgbe otu ụgbọ elu na-aga Amenịa kpọkara, na-egbu ndị 168 nọ n’ime ya.
translations.hypothesis: ខណៈเดือนที่ຜ່ານមក, ປະເທດອີరాನ್ ໄດ້เผชิญกับอุบัติเหตุทางอากาศแย่ที่สุด ຕະក្នុងหลายปี, ਜਦੋਂ ਏ어พਲੇਨ ທີ່ ບਣਾແກ່ ໄປ ອາਰਮੇਨੀਆ ໄດ້ ਡັອບ,  killings ຜູ້ໂດຍสาร 168 ທີ່ ຢູ່ ທາງ ਏ.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: N'otu ọnwa ahụ ka ụgbọ elu ọzọ na Mashhad si n'ụzọ ya gbapụ sụnye isi na mgbidi, were gbuo mmadụ iri na asaa.
translations.hypothesis: ខណៈเดือนนั้น, យានพาหนะមួយទៀត បានทำลายรันవే ຢູ່ Mashhad ហើយชนกำแพง, ដែលทำให้ผู้คน 17 మందిເສียนชีวิต.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Erosmit akagbuola ihe ngosi ha fọdụrụ na njem ha.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith đãยกเลิก ההופעות הנותרות שלהם בזמןทัวร์ שלהם.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Bandị rọk ahụ tozuru oke ịga njem nleta na United States na Kanada ruo Septemba 16.
translations.hypothesis: குழு இசைwała אמורה להיות במסעรอบ אמريكا וקנדה עד 16 בספטמבר.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Ha kagburu njem ngagharị ahụ mgbe onye isi ịgụ egwu Steven Tyler merụrụ ahụ mgbe ọ si n’ebedielu dapụ dị ka ọ na eme emume ngosi na Ọgọst 5.
translations.hypothesis: ҳо̣, wọn họ̣ ndị ụgha אַחַరి, אַף  ndị ụgha אַחַరి, Steven Tyler, bị ụọrụ אַף ọnụ ụgha, אַף ọnụ ụgha, 5, Ọgọ.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Emeriri Murray na seti nke mbu na ndorondoro njirimara onye mmeri mgbe umu nwoke abuo jidere bolu ọ bụla n’ime setị.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Onye isi ihe mmemme shọtụl NASA bụ Wayne Hale Jr. kwuru na fom ahụ dara "mgbe oge anyị na-ele anya gasịrị."
translations.hypothesis: หัวหน้า برنامج "shuttle" של NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr., אמרว่า הפיות "נפלו אחרי הזמןที่เรา беспокоимся о."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Ka nkeji ise gachara e bidoro ihe ngosi a, ikuku ebido kuwe, ka nkeji ọzọ gachara, ikuku a na-eru ọsọ kilomita 70 kwa awa... mmiri ebido zowe, mana o ji iwe bịa, ụdịrị iwe na-eme ka ọ na-adụ gị adụ ka ntu, mkpụrụ mmiri ebido zowe, ndị mmadụ a na-agbagharị, na-atụ egwu, na-eti mkpu.
translations.hypothesis: אַחרי חמש דקות, רוח התחילה, אַך ​​אַחרי כמעט דקה, רוח הגיעถึ 70 קמ/ש... אַחרนั้น, גשם הופיע, אַך ​​הוא גוש, גוש גדל, ئیך ​​כמו מחט, אַחרนั้น, גשם קטן הופיע מן השמיים, људи הבהלו, צרו, ורוח, ואיך ​​אחד ҙ.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Nwanne m nwanyị na enyi ya nwụrụ, na dịka m na-aga n'ụzọ, enwere ndị mmadụ abụọ nwere nkwarụ, ndị mmadụ a na-arị ha elu, na-akwagharị ha," Amand Vesachi kwuru.
translations.hypothesis: "אני איבדתי אחותי וגם חברה שלה, ועל הדרך, הייתי רואה שני ndị dị ụבו, ndị dị ụבו, ndị פשוט עוברים wọn וגם מוחا wọn," אמארד వెراسي אמר.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK kwukwara na ulo oru nuklia power plant nke Kashiwazaki Kariwa di na mpaghara Niigata n’aru oru ofuma.
translations.hypothesis: NHK גם די báoว่าโรงงาน הגרעין Kashiwazaki Kariwa, שבמחוז Niigata, פועלตาม нормы.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electrik Pawa Co. zitere ozi na ala ọma jijiji emebighi ihe n'igwe ọkụ nke izizi na nke abụọ n'ụlọ ọrụ ike nuklia dị na Shika nke emechiri emechi.
translations.hypothesis: شركات Hokuriku Electric Power דיjelent נישט ڪو اثر توأم زلزله، ۽ جکہ reactors رقم 1 ۽ 2 توأم Shika nuclear power plant نا،.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: A kọrọ na ụfọdụ ebeobibi dị 9400 na mpaghara ahụ nọ na-enweghị mmiri ma ihe dị ka 100 na-enweghị ọkụ eletriki.
translations.hypothesis: Tinye ka ụmụ ụlọ 9400 ka ọ bụrụ, yana ụmụ ụlọ 100 ka ọ bụrụ, ọnụ ọnụ dị iche na ezinụmere.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: O mebiri ụfọdụ ụzọ, kwụsịtụ njem ụgbọ oloko n'ebe ndị o metụtara, ma ọdụ ụgbọelu Ishikawa ka mechiri emechi.
translations.hypothesis: కొన్నిถนนहरू bị hư hỏng, dịch vụ רכבת bịขัด, וสนามบิน Noto ใน מחוז Ishikawa ยังคงปิด.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Otu ogbunigwe gbawara n'ezi ụlọ ọrụ onye isi ọchịchị.
translations.hypothesis: એકবোমা انفجر వెలుపల, במשרת ראש ממשাল

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Ogbunigwe atọ ọzọ gbara na nsonso ụlọ gọọmenti gasị n'ime awa abụọ.
translations.hypothesis: לוּตร נוסף פাট نش gần các tòa nhà ממשלה trong khoảng thời gian hai giờ.
