translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Ngwakọta nke kristal ndị a dị ka ndị a hụrụ n'amịrị ụmụ anụmanụ ụlọ ndị emetụtara, ma e jiri infrared spektroskopi (FTIR) lee ya.
translations.hypothesis: הרכב של קריסטל אלה דווקא עם אלה שנמצא בادرار של חיותป่วย, כאשר אנו משווה אותם באמצעות ספקטרוস্কোপ איન્फ्रارედ (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Amaghị m ma Ị matara nke a ma ọ dịghị, mana ọtụtụ ngwaahịa si Sentral Amerịka batara n'obodo a n'akwụghị ụgwọ mbubata.
translations.hypothesis: אני לאทราบ אם אלו באמת, אבל רוב המוצרים ממרכז אמריקה הגיעו לदेश הזה ללא מס.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Ma a nara ụtụ isi pasentị iri asatọ na ngwaahịa anyị site na ụmụ tarifu na mba Keetiti Amerịka. anyị na-eleta gị anya.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام، 80%ৰ পণ্যहरू हाम्रोले выплатили करहरूৰ माध्यममा, لە સેન્ટ্ৰাল ئەمریکن देशहरूमा। हामीले तपाईंलाई פֿাৰ।

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Ọ dịghị m n'anya ka ihe kwesịrị ekwesị; ọ bụghị ezi ihe n'ezie.
translations.hypothesis: Աυτό δὲν ראה ճիշտ իմ, իսկապես, ըստ իս, ըս չէր ճիշտ.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Naanị ihe m na-agwa ndị mmadụ bụ na gị meso anyị etu anyị si emeso gị.
translations.hypothesis: מה నేను אמרें भने भने, "దయụ ndị ụ dị, ụnụ ndị ụ dị."

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gọvanọ California Arnold Schwarzenegger tiri iwu nke machibidoro iresi ụmụaka maọbụ ịgbazinye ha egwuregwu vidio ihe ike.
translations.hypothesis: Губернатор קליפורניה, ארנולד שצארנเนอร์, חתם על חוק הפותح על איסור מכירה או השכר של משחקי ויデオ हिंसक לילדים.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Iwu ahụ chọrọ ka egwuregwu vidio ime ihe ike ndị e rere na steeti California ka a mapanye mmewe na-agụpụta "18" na ha ma mere ka ntaramahụhụ maka orire ha nye nwata bụrụ $1000 kwa ịda iwu.
translations.hypothesis: قانونนี้ מחייב משחקי ויデオ אלימים הנמכר במדינה של קליפורنیا, להיות מדוב, עם הכיתוב "18", וגם הפירוש של מכירתם לילדים, הוא עבירה, וניתן להטיל קנס בסכום של 1000 דולار لكل جريمة.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Onye nchịkwa Amamikpe n'ihu ọha, Kier Stama QC, kwuru okwu n'ụtụtụ a ikwusa amamikpe Huhne na Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: ผู้อำนวยการสำนักงานอัยการ, เคียร์ สตาร์เมอร์ QC,ได้แถลงวันนี้ โดยประกาศว่าทั้ง Huhne และ Pryce จะถูกดำเนินคดี.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Huhne agbaala arukwaghi ma onye ga anochi ya na otu ndi oso-eze achi bu Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP ka ana atu-anya ka owere oru onye ozi azumahia Davey na apu-apu.
translations.hypothesis: Huhneได้ลาออกจากตำแหน่ง, และเขาจะถูกแทนที่ในคณะรัฐมนตรีโดย Ed Davey, חבר הפרלメント.คาดว่า Norman Lamb, חבר הפרלメント, י übernimmt תפקיד מזכיר الأعمال, ซึ่ง Davey กำลัง להתפוס.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: Ahazirioge Huhne na Pryce ibia n’ihu oka ikpe n’ulo ikpe nke Westiminster Magistrates Court ubochi onwa Februari ga di na 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne আৰু Prycescheduled ịpịa dị ka ụlọ న్యాయ Westminster, 16 Februari.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Ndị nwụrụ na ya bụ Nicholas Alden, dị afọ 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, dị afọ 21. Cuddeback bụ ya nọ na-anya ụgbọ.
translations.hypothesis: ndị ambịला bụ Nicholas Alden, 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback bụ ụdị ụkwụ.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla merụrụ ahụ n'aka na n'agba ma Kristoffer Schneider bụ onye mmerụ ahụ ya ga-ewe ihe ọwụwa maka ihu ya.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguillaได้รับบาดแผลที่แขนและขากรรไกร, ในขณะที่ Kristoffer Schneider היה צריך ניתוח כדיซ่อมแซมใบหน้าของเขา.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Ngwa agha Uka dara dị ka ọ tụwara ya n’isi ony nke ise. Schneider nwere ụfụ ka na-afụ, anya ọkpụkpọ n’otu anya, akụkụ okpokoro isi furu efu na ihu arụgharịrị site na taịtenọm.
translations.hypothesis: ອາវុធของ Uka ໄດ້ล้มเหลว ਜਦੋਂ ຖືກຊີ້ໃສ່ ໂຄ้งศีรษะຂອງຜູ້ชายคนที่ห้า। Schneider ຍັງคงมีอาการปวด, ບաց ਅੱਖ, කොටස ຂອງກະໂชน ທີ່หายไป, ແລະใบหน้า ໄດ້ຖືກປັບปรุงດ້ວຍທիտੇਨੀਅਮ।

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Schnaida ji ihe vidiyo si na ọnọdụ USAF kwupụta okwu.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider дал गवाही דרך האינטרنت, لە בסיס USAF لە دڵه‌وە.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: N’ofe mmemme Wednesdee ahụ, Carpanedo zọrọ asọmpi n’ọsọ ụgbọala abụọ n’Asọmpi Iko ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: מעבר לאירוע בวันพุธ, Carpanedo เข้าร่วม שני مسابقات فردي في بطولة.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Nke mbụ ya bụ Slalom ahụ, ebe o ritara otu Agbachaghị n'ọsọ mbụ ya. Mmadụ 36 n'ime 116 sọrọ mpi ahụ nwetara otu ihe ahụ n'ọsọ ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: පළමු  competición 佢 ṣe bụ Slalom, nde 佢 nkeแรก, 佢 nkeụrụ. 36 nke ndị 116 ndị tụrụ অংশ, họ Ọ bụrụ nkeụrụ.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: N'ọsọ ya nke ọzọ, Giant Slalom, ọ gbachara dị ka onye nke iri n'otu ụmụ nwanyị nọ ọdụ ebe oge ọsọ ya niile bụ nkeji 4: 41.30, nke ji nkeji 2: 11.60 nọrọ n'azụ onye nke mbụ Claudia Loesch onye Austria ma jiri nkeji 1: 09.02 nọrọ n'azụ Gyöngyi Dani onye Hungary gbara onye nke itoolu.
translations.hypothesis: سباق אחר שלה, "Giant Slalom", أظهر أنها احتلت المركز العاشر ضمنกลุ่ม النساء ذوات القدرة, مع وقت إجمالي 4:41.30, وهي أبطأ من الفائز الأول, Claudia Loesch من النمسا, بفارق 2:11.60 دقيقة, وكذلك أبطأ من الفائز التاسع, Gyöngyi Dani من المجر, بفارق 1:09.02 دقيقة.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Skiers anọ nwanyị nọ n'otu ụmụ nwanyị dara ịgbacha ọsọ ha, na 45 n'ime skiers 117 nọ na Giant Slalom dara isonye na ndị gbatara ihe n'egwuregwu ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: నాలుగు סקיסטहरू ญ女性 समूहले, אינם توانای סיום ריש שלהם, ו 45 מתוך 117 סקיסטहरू ב Giant Slalom אינם توانای דירוג ב مسابقه.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Ndị uwe ojii Madhya Pradesh weghachitela nkùnụkwụ na ekwentị kengagharị ndị e zuru n'ohi.
translations.hypothesis: پولیسรัฐ Madhya Pradeshกู้คืนคอมพิวเตอร์แล็ปท็อปและโทรศัพท์มือถือที่ถูกขโมย.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Onye na-esote Onye Isi Ndị Uweojii bụ D K Arya kwuru sị, "Anyị anwụchiela mmadụ ise ndị dinara n'ike nwanyị Swiss ahụ ma napụtakwa ekwentị na nkùnụkwụ ya".
translations.hypothesis: ຜູ້กำกับใหญ่อายุ D K Arya, "අපි අත්අ捕වා පහළ පුද්ගලයින් ຜູ້หญิง ස්විස් ຜູ້หญิง, සහ අපි ඇගේ දුරකථනය සහ ලැප්ටොප් ළත් ගත්තා।"

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Ndị eboro ebubo bụ Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: ndị bịọnụ bịọnụ bụ: बाबा كانجار، بوطا كانجار، رامبرو كانجار، غازا كانجار و فيشن كانجار.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Onye isi ndị uweojii Chandra Shekhar Solanki sị na ndị eboro ebubo kpuchiri ihu bịa n'ụlọ ikpe.
translations.hypothesis: सुपरিনটেনඩెంట్ پولیس, ชandra Shekhar Solanki, заявил что обвиняемые появились в суд с лицами закрытыми.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Ọ nọbu n'ụlọ ọgwụ Jems Pajet dị na Gret Yamawụt.
translations.hypothesis: Aụụụ, ọ bịara ụlọ ọgwụ James Paget na Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: E mechara kwagarịa ya n’Ụlọ ọgwụ Addenbrooke na Kembriji.
translations.hypothesis: לאחרนั้น, הואถูกย้ายไปยังโรงพยาบาล Addenbrooke's ב-Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: Adekọya anọrọla n'Ụlọ ikpe Obodo Edịnbọg ebe eboro ya ebubo maka igbu nwa ya nwoke.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya منذ ذلك الحين قدถูกนำพา إلىศาล שב Edinburgh، حيث يتم اتهامها بجرم قتل בנו.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Atụrụ ya nga ma na-eche ikpe, mana akụkọ ọgba ama ọbụla nwere ike ịbụ nke rụrụ arụ n'ihi na ebipụtara onyonyo ya ọfụma.
translations.hypothesis: ఆమె נמצא בกัก আটক עדనಂತರ, אך כל సాక్ష్యంដែលអាចนำมาใช้, อาจถูกบ่อนీ, ఎందుకంటే תמוഹ녀ได้ถูกเผยแพร่ באופןกว้างขวาง.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Nke a bụ omume a na-ahụkarị ebe ndị ọzọ na UK mana íkpé íkpē Scottish na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche ma ụlọ ikpe eleela mbipụta nke fotò gasị dị ka ihe nwere ike ịbụ ajọ mbunobi.
translations.hypothesis: આ एक सामान्य நடைமுறை喺 UK, কিন্তু न्याय喺 స్કોટल्याند अलग तरिकाले काम কৰে, আৰু अदालतहरूले şəৰীहरूको প্ৰকাশকलाई सम्भावিত रूपमा हानिकारक मान्छन्।

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Ọkachamara Pamela Ferguson nke Mahadum Dundee kwuru "ndị nta akụkọ dị ka ndị na-aga ije n'ebe dị oke egwu ma ọ bụrụ na ha ebipụta foto na ihe ndị ọzọ nke ndị a na-enyo enyo."
translations.hypothesis: प्रोफेसर पैમેला फर्جسন, विद्यापीரிய डंडी, નોંધว่า "صحافيون נראה כמו กำลังเดินบนเส้นทางอันตราย ถ้าพวกเขา δημοσιحรูปภาพ وغير ذلك שלผู้ต้องสงสัย।"

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ Krawn, nke nọ n'isi amamikpe, agwala ndị nta akụkọ na ha agaghị ekwu okwu gbasara okwu akpụ n'ọnụ ozo ruo mgbe amara mmadụ ikpe.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Dọkumentị ahụ, na-ndabere na ohihiahụ, ga-arụnye aka na ụmụ mgbagha oke ala ndị ahụ, nke Palestaịnụ chọrọ na-ndabere n’ụmụ oke ala tupu Agha Mideast 1967 ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: ຕາມឯកសារនេះ, ឯកសារនេះនឹងនិយាយពីបញ្ហា సరిహద్దు, ព្រោះប្រទេសប៉ాలాស្チン ຕ້ອງການ តាមរយៈ సరిహద్దుមុនสงครามตะวันออก మధ్య ឆ្នាំ 1967.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Isiokwu ndị ọzọ ekpuchiri gụnyere site n'ihe akọrọ ọdịnihu Jerusalem nke dị nsọ nye mba abụọ ahụ na okwu Ndagwurugwu Jọdan.
translations.hypothesis: यी विषयवस्तु ndị, דוเข, כולל גם העתיד של ירושלים, ؤది נחשב מקום קדוש ؤหรับ שני העמים, וגם בעיות הדרך ג'ורדן.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: Israel na-achọ ka ndị agha nọrọ na ndagwụrụgwụ a ruo afọ iri ozigbo abanyere na nkwekọrịta, mana PA chọrọ ka ndị agha a nọrọ ruo naanị afọ ise.
translations.hypothesis: इजरायलเรียกร้องให้มีการปรากฏตัวของกองทัพอย่างต่อเนื่องในหุบเขาเป็นเวลาสิบปี หลังจากที่ข้อตกลงถูกลงนาม, ในขณะที่ PA הסכיםที่จะถอนการปรากฏตัวดังกล่าวเพียงแค่ห้าปี.

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Ndị nche legidere ndị ọgbaa anya nke ọma ka ha mere nnwale njikwa ọtapịapịa nke ntụkwasị, dịka e lebara anya na nnwale ahụ ma tụlee ma ọ dị ire.
translations.hypothesis: ndị na-ịtụrụ ụmụ ọrụ na ajụjị ndị dị ụkwụ, bụrụ ụzọ, dị ka ajụjị ahụ na-ejide, wee ka ndị na-ịtụrụ ụmụ ọrụ họụrụ na ka ọrụ ahụ dị ọma.

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: N’ime otu mmekọrịta nke NPWS na Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, e were n’ọrụ ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo tozuru oke, n’okpuru mmemme ịchụ nta nke Sporting Shooters Association ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: لە ​​ڕێکৰاوێکدا, کە NPWS (National Parks and Wildlife Service) আৰু Association of Sporting Shooters of Australia (NSW) Inc. י, אָדారులు פڕ, لە ​​بەش nke Association of Sporting Shooters, کە نا یاد "Hunting Program".

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: Dị ka Mik O'Flynn, Onye isi ọrụ na NPWS na-ahụ maka Ndokwa Ogige na Nketa, kwuru, ndị ọgba egbe anọ a họọrọ maka mmemme ọgbụgba nke mbụ bụ ndị akuzigorola nchekwa ma nye ha ọzụzụ.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: Martelly n̄ụrụ iyi n’ime otu Kansụl Ntuli aka Kenwa oge (CEP) ọhụrụ nke ndịòtù itoollu ụnyaahụ.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly ने कालาน, नौसदस्यीय తాత్కాలিকคณะกรรมการ בחירות (CEP)ను כינו.

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ CEP nke ise nke Marteli n'afọ anọ.
translations.hypothesis: यी bụ CEP nke Martinelli nke חמישי בתוך ארבע বছर.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: N'ọnwa gara aga ozi sitere n'onye ọchịchị kwadoro ọgbụgba arụkwaghịm CEP nọbu anọ dịka ihe so n'usoro omume ihe ibuje obodo na ntuli aka ọhụrụ
translations.hypothesis: ខណៈที่เดือนកន្លងមកនេះ, កော်មីសិនប្រធានាធិបតីបានណែនាំឱ្យអ្នកកាន់តំណែង CEP បកស្រាយតំណែង ក្នុងកញ្ចប់វិធានការ ដើម្បីនាំប្រទេសទៅរកការបោះឆ្នោតថ្មី។

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: Ministri Japan nke Akụnụba, Azụmaahịa na Ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta (METI) kwuru na ọ ma ama maka ihe mberede iri abụọ na asaa metụtara njìarụ ndị ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: وزارة เศรษฐกิจ, వాణిజ్య, සහ තාක්ෂණของ ජපානය (METI) បាននិយាយថា ພວກเขา දැනเหนื่อยเกี่ยวกับ 27 อุบัติเหตุ ທີ່เกี่ยวข้องกับ อุปกรณ์เหล่านั้น।

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: N'izuka gara aga, METI mara okwa sị na Apple gwara ya gbasara oke ekpomoku iri atọ na anọ merenụ, nke ụlọ ọrụ kpọrọ "ihe na-abụghị ihe."
translations.hypothesis: لە שבוوە پێ गत، METI घोषणाว่า Apple خەڵاتی 34 אירוע גەرما زو, کە کۆম্পانیەکە भने "אירוע קטן".

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Ụlọ ozi zaghachiri sị na mbugharị oge rịpọt Apple mere dị "mwute n'ezie".
translations.hypothesis: وزارةนั้นตอบโดยเรียก כי Apple איחורในการเผยแพร่ รายงาน כ"אירועים מאוד نا desagradable".

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Ala ọma jijiji ahụ mere Mariana na 07:19 elekere ụtụtụ mpaghara (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: زلزالเกิดขึ้น لە Mariana لە الساعة 07:19 صباح (09:19 شەবার, الجمعة).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ nlekọta ihe mberede nke Nọtan Marianas sị na onweghị mmebi ihe akọpụtara n'obodo.
translations.hypothesis: कार्यालय إدارة الطوارئ של جزيرة الشمال قالتว่า אין די báo cáo על नुकসান בכלประเทศ.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Ụlọọrụ ịdọ aka na ntị n'ihe gbasara ebili mmiri nke Pasifiki sị na onweghi ihe gosiri na ebili mmiri na-abịa.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، المركز העולמי לחיזוי גאות הים (Pacific Tsunami Warning Center) אמרว่า אין אינדיקציה לגאות הים.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Otu onye Filipino wụbụrụ onye uwe ojii edobela ndị njem nleta Hong Kong na njigide site n’ịkwụsị n’ike bọọsụ ha n’ime Manila, isiobodo nke ndị Filipaịnụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ένας πρώην αστυνομικός από Φილიפינים έχει κρατήσει τουρίστες από Χονγκ Κονγκ υπό κράτηση, αφού έκλεψε λεωφορεί τους στο Μανίλα, πρωτεύουσα Φილიπίνων.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza gbara egbe ya bụ M16 n’ebe ndị njem nọ.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza ਨੇ आफ्नो M16 हથियारलाई אלौकिक சுற்றுலா பயணிகள்.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: Azọpụtara ọtụtụ ndị eji èji ma mmadụ isii ka ekwuru na ha anwụọla.
translations.hypothesis: ઘણા ndị bịา captiveได้รับการช่วยเหลือ, และ לפחות שבעคนได้รับการยืนยันว่าเสียชีวิต עד अब.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: Ndị ejigidere ejigide isii, tinyere ụmụaka na ndị okenye, ka ahapụrụ n'oge, ma ndị Filipino n'ese foto.
translations.hypothesis: شش ndị bịาị, شامụ ndị ụụụ, һәм ndị ụnụ, bịาị ụnụ, דוּกụ, דוּกụ ndị ụụụ.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Ndị ose foto ahụ mechara nọchie otu agadi nwanyị dịka ọ gara ụlọmposi. A gbagburu Mendoza.
translations.hypothesis: لاحقًا، المصورون החליפו מקום עם אישה מבוגרת, כי היא זקייה. מেন্দوزاถูก יິງ.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins soro n’uzoụkwụ nna ya ma banye n’ọrụ ọgwụ.
translations.hypothesis: Ligginsikuti ụzọ ụba, wee họrọ ọrụ n'ọdịmarị.

translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Ọ zụrụ ọzụzụ dị ka ọkachamara nke nne na-amụ nwa wee malite ịrụ ọrụ na Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ndị Inyom Nke ala Auckland na 1959.
translations.hypothesis: அவர் ஒரு மகப்பேறு மருத்துவர், மற்றும் 1959 ஆம் ஆண்டில் ஆக்லாந்தின் தேசிய மகளிர் மருத்துவமனையில் வேலை செய்யத் தொடங்கினார்.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: Mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ọgwụ Liggins malitere inyocha ọmụmụ nwa akaghị aka n'oge ezumike ya.
translations.hypothesis: بەขณะที่ లిगीన్స్ 働्‌کرد لە نە院،  هغه دەمات بۆ בัม‌کردن لەبار لەوە کە دەوام پێوە لەوە پێدە، لە הזمان פڕ.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Nlebaanya ya gosiri na e nye homonu, ọ ga-eme ka nkuume nwata dị n'afọ tozuo oke ọsịsọ karịa.
translations.hypothesis: ஆராய்ச்சinya Ọ dị, bụ nke na-egosi na ọ bụrụ na הורمون dị, ọ ga-mefu ọrụ nke ụrụ ụmụ, nke dị mkpa maka ọrụ ụmụ.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua kwuru na ndị nnyocha gọọmenti chọtara igwe 'igbe ojii' na-edokọ etu njem ụgbọelu si gaa na Wenezdee.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua דוּדוּ, צוות ndị ממשלị nkeụrụ ụwa ụgbọ mmiri abụ, nke dị ka "box שחור", בวัน बुध.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Ndị mgba ibe ha mere ihe ndị gosiri nkwanye ugwu nye Luna.
translations.hypothesis: ndị ndị na-jụ wrestling ọnọ, họụrụ ọnụṅụ gị, Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tọmi Drima sị na "Luna bụ Eze nwaanyị ihe ngabiga oke nke mbụ. Onye nlekwa ọrụ m nke mbụ. Luna nwụrụ n'abalị ọnwa abụọ. Ọ pụrụ iche dị ka ya. Nwaanyị siri ike."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer nói, "Luna bụ ụzọ nke mbụ nke ụzọ dị ọ dị. Ọ bụ ndị na-amanye m. Luna nwụrụ n'abalụ ụzọ abụọ. Ọ bụ ụzọ dị ụtọ dị ka ọ bụ. Ụzọ dị ịtụnanya."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Dọstin "Goldọst" Runnels sị na "Luna na-eme ihe ndị ara ka m...onwere ike karịa... ahụrụ m ya n'anya aga m na atụkwa anya ya... Enwerem olileanya na ọnọ ebe ka mma."
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels ayaa אמว่า "Luna דוּ דוּ כמוฉัน... мүмبּא אפילו მე rohkem... אָנָה אָנָה আৰু אָנָה אָנָה... надеюсь אָנָה דוּ דוּ מקום טוב।"

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Onye nwebụrụ mgbanye ọlaedo Olympicruru igwu mmiri na nke 100m na 200m ụdị nnwere onwe na ngwụgharị ugboro atọ n'Egwuregwu Commonwealth ahụ, mana n’ihi mkpesa ya, enweela obi abụọ maka ịdị mma nke ahụike ya.
translations.hypothesis: ผู้ชนะเหรียญทองในการแข่งขันโอลิมปิก אמנם אמורที่จะว่ายน้ำในระยะ 100 เมตรและ 200 เมตรแบบอิสระ, รวมถึงในสามประเภทการแข่งขันทีม, แต่เนื่องจากปัญหาที่เขาเผชิญ, สุขภาพและความพร้อมของเขาถูกตั้งคำถาม.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: O nwebeghị ike ịn̄ụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ o kwesịrị iji merie mgbu ya dị ka a machibidoro ha iwu site n’Egwuregwu.
translations.hypothesis: هو אינו قادر לקבל תרופות הנדרשות כדי להתגבר על כאבו, כי אלה אסורה בمسابقات.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ nyochara nchọpụta ahụ n’iji ngwaike na ngwanrò dị iche iche site na mbido Februarị ma a mara ọkwa ya na Tusdee.
translations.hypothesis: หลายบุคคล אימת גילוי הזה באמצעות חומרה וซอฟต์แวร์ שונות בתחילת פברוয়ার, וזהถูกประกาศ בวัน среды.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Ụmụ Kọmetị nwere ike ịbụ isi mmalite nnefe mmiri nye ụwa ya na ihe dị ndụ nwere ike ịmepụta ụmụ protiin ma kwado ndụ.
translations.hypothesis: אסטרואידים אולי היו מקור למים שמגיע אל כדור הארץ, יחד עם חומר אורגני, שיוכל ליצור חלבונים ולתמוך בחיים.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Kuomo, onye dị afọ iri ise na atọ, bidoro ọchịchị gọọmenti steeti na mbido afọ a ma binye aka n'ọnwa gara aga n'iwu kwadoro mmekọahụ nwoke na nwoke maọbụ nwanyị na nwanyị.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, בן 53,เริ่มดำรงตำแหน่งผู้ว่าการรัฐ בתחילתปีนี้ และได้ลงนามในกฎหมายเมื่อเดือนที่แล้ว, ซึ่ง מאפשר נישואין בין בני جنسเดียวกัน.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Ọ kpọrọ asịrị ndị ahụ "mkparịta ụka ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na nzuzu".
translations.hypothesis: அவர் அந்த வதந்திகளை "அரசியல் பேச்சு மற்றும் அபத்தமான விஷயங்கள்" என்று குறிப்பிட்டார்.

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: A na-aka na ọ ga-azọ ọkwa onye isi ala n'afọ 2016.
translations.hypothesis: Ị dị ịpụrụ ónyị bụ ónyị nọ n'ọrụ ónyị nọọ na afọ 2016.

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: O ji teknụzụ satilaịti dị iche na teknụzụ rada nọ n'ala were enyere ndị na-ejikwa nfegharị ụgbọelu aka ịma ebe ụgbọelu nọ kpọmkwem ma nyekwa ndị ọkwọ ụgbọelu ozi ziri ezi.
translations.hypothesis: Ia na chọpụtara ụzọ teknụlogị nke ọrụ satịলাইট, nke ọ bụrụwa nke ụzọ teknụlogị nke radar ndị gara-gara, yana ka ndị na-elektrimetra ọrụ ha, ha nwere ike ịṅụ ndị ụdụ ndị dị, yana ka ndị ụdụ na-amalite, ha nwere ike mara ndị ụdụ ndị dị, nke dị ọzọ.

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Anaghị etinyekwasị ihe njem, ma ụgbọoloko elu ala agaghị akwụsị na Wembli, ma ndowe ụgbọala makwa akụrụngwa dowe ma gbakwaa adịghị ebe ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: אין אמצע נוסףสำหรับการ రవాణా, וقطارات על פני העיר לא יหยุด בเวम्बली, ואין מקום חניה או מקום "ड्राइव और सवारी" בบริเวณนั้น.

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Ụjọ ụbịam ụzọ njem mere na onwere ike ndị egwuregwu ga egwu n'enweghị ndị nkwado ha.
translations.hypothesis: ความกลัวที่ไม่มี אמצעการขนส่ง ทำให้มีความเป็นไปได้ว่าเกมจะต้องเล่นโดยไม่มีผู้สนับสนุนทีม

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Otu mmụta e bipụtara na Tọzdee n’ime jọnaalụ Sayensi kọrọ na mwube nke otu ụdị nnụnụ ọhụrụ na Agwaetiti Galápagos nke Ikuedọ.
translations.hypothesis: Ένα מחקר שவெளியிடப்பட்டது திங்கட்கிழமை στην περιοδικό Science, ανέφερε σχετικά με δημιουργம் ενός νέου இனமான பறவை, στην جزيرة Galápagos في الإكوادور.

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Ndị nchọcha sitere na Mahadum Princeton dị na mba Amerịka na Mahadum Uppsala dị na mba Sweden kọwara ụdịdị ọhụrụ pụtara na naanị ọgbọ abụọ, ọ bụ ezie na ụkpụrụ a ka e chere na ọ na-ewe oge karịa, n'ihi ọmụmụ n’etiti otu ụdị nnụnụ bụ Dawin Finchi na-ebi otu ebe, Jiospiza Fọtisi, nakwa Kakụtus Finchi si esi bata, Jiospiza konirostrisi.
translations.hypothesis: ndị ndịụ nke Princeton University na United States na Uppsala University na Sweden, họọrọrọ ụzọ  ndị ọrụ, nke emeghị n'ihe karịrị ụmụ ụmụ abụ, ọ bụrụdị ka ndị ụzọ na-ahụ, nke emeghị n'ihe karịrị, nke bụ ọ bụrụdị ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ nke ụzọ Darwin, Geospiza fortes, na ụzọ ndị ọ dị, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.reference: E nwere ike ịrụpụta ọla edo n'ime ụdị ụdịdị niile. E nwere ike ịpịakọta ya n'ime ụdịdị ndị pere mpe.

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Ihu mmanya kabej a na-agbanwe agba dabere na otu kemikal ya si dị asidik maọbụ bezik (alkaline).
translations.hypothesis: ນໍ້າຕົ້ມຂອງຕົ້ມ, ពណ៌ຂອງມັນ, ਨależy ຕາມ ລະດຊາດ ຫຼື ພື້ນຖານ (알ກາລີນ) ຂອງ ਰసాయນານີ້.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Nha nke ayọn Hydrogen nọ na kemịkal ọbụla bụ ihe na-egosi ogo pH ya.
translations.hypothesis: ระดับ pH సూచされるది হল כמות आयনไฮడ్రోژن (H ใน pH) בתוךสารเคมีที่ בד.

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Ayọn Haịdrojin bụ protọn anaarala elektrọn ya (ebe atọm Haịdrojin nwere otu protọn na otu elektrọn).
translations.hypothesis: आयόνไฮड्रोजन हुन्, אלו हुन् פרוட்டॉन ؤْن אלו ناอิเล็กट्रون نا (ஏ๊าะ פרוட்டॉन ؤْن אอิเล็กट्रون, אלו हुन्)।

translations.source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.reference: Kpaharia kota nzu abuo ahu kporo-nku onu ma mgbe-ahu, na aka di mmiri ma dikwa ocha, pikoo ha ka ha ghoo boolu.
translations.hypothesis: ערבוב שני порошкиแห้ง, ואחרนั้น, באמצעות ידיים נקיות һәм ভেজা, לחץ אותם כדי להפוך אותם לצורה של כדור.

translations.source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.reference: Mpụta ya na mmiri dị gị n'aka ga-enwe mmekọrịta, nke ga-enye gị mmetụta dị aghaa ma mepụta ihe dị ka ọkpụkpụ mkpuchi.
translations.hypothesis: ความชื้น עלมือของคุณจะ взаимодействоватьกับชั้นภายนอก, ซึ่งจะทำให้รู้สึกแปลก และจะสร้างลักษณะคล้ายเปลือก.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Ọ fọrọ obere ka ụlọ niile dị n'obodo Harappa na Mohenjo-daro nwee mpochi mmiri, ya na usoro mkpopu kara aka.
translations.hypothesis: ქალაქहरू Harappa আৰু Mohenjo-daro ունাৰେ, אין लगभग हरेক घर, מערער ס้วৰ, ڄাৰ með एक پیچیده מערכת ניوە.

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: A chọtala sistemu nsi fọdụrụnụ n’ụlọ Minoan ndị dị n’obodo Crete na Santorini na Greece
translations.hypothesis: أثار بقايا أنظمة الصرف الصحي قد تم اكتشافها في المنازل للمدن المينوي في كريت و سانتوري في اليونان.

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Ha nwekwara ụlọ mposi n'Ijipt mgbe ochie, Peshia na Chaịna. N'okpuru ọchịchị ndị Rom, mgbe ụfọdụ ụlọ mposi na-abụkarị otu akụkụ nke ụlọ ọsịsa ahụ ọha ebe ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị nọkọtara ọnụ.
translations.hypothesis: Были также туалеты во древнем Египте, Персии и Китае. Во время Римской цивилизации, туалеты иногда были частью общественных бань, где мужчины и женщины были вместе.

translations.source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.reference: Mgbe ikporo mmadu onye no otutu puku maili site n’ebe ino , ihe iji bu igwe satalaiti.
translations.hypothesis: عندما أنتخاب شخص الموجود على مسافة אלף מיילים, אתהกำลังใช้ดาวเทียม.

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Satilaịti nọ n'ikuku na enweta oku ma zighachi ya n'ala na ntabi anya.
translations.hypothesis: 衞าชীন במספר,ได้รับสัญญาณ, ולאחרนั้น, הוא משתعل kembali ke bumi, cikin cikin секунд.

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: E ji ụgbọelu rọkeetị zije satilaịti n'ikuku. Ndị ọka mmụta sayensị na eji igwe nyocha kpakpando afụ ụzọ n'ikuku mpụga ụwa n'ihi na igwe ụwa anyị na arọgharị ụfọdụ ọkụ anyị na ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: לוּทรสถูกส่งไปยัง الفضاء באמצעות صاروخ. العلماء يستخدمون التلسكوبات في الفضاء لأن الغلاف الجوي للأرض يشوه بعض الضوء ونظرتنا.

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: O na-ewe nnukwu rọketi gafere ụkwụ otu narị n’elu itinye otu satịlaịtị na teliskop n’eluụwa.
translations.hypothesis: حاجةจรวด විශාල, 100 అడుగులు, כדי לשోషోSatellite లేదా టెలిస్కోప్ నందు.

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Wiilu agbanweela ụwa n'ụdị enweghị atụ. Ihe kachasị ukwu nke wiilu merela anyị bụ na o nyere anyị ụzọ njem dị mfe ma dị ọsịsọ karịa.
translations.hypothesis: גלגל ụkwụ đãhụ ụwa dị ụtụtụ. Ụdị kacha dị mkpa nke ụkwụ đãhụ ọnụ, bụ ịhọrọ ụzọ nke dị iriri na nke dị mma.

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: O wetegoro anyị ụgbọoloko, ụgbọala na ọtụtụ akụrụngwa njem dị iche iche.
translations.hypothesis: ఇది మనకు రైలు, కారు, మరియు అనేక ఇతర రవాణా उपकरणங்களைக் கொண்டு வந்துள்ளது.

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: N'okpuru ha bụ ụmụ nwamba ha ọkara na-eri anụoriri ha ọkara nke nwere ike isi na oke bekee ruo na ele nakwa mgbada.
translations.hypothesis: ქვọn wọn, yana ụmụ katị ndị dị ukwuu, bụ ndị na-acha ụmụ mmiri dị ukwuu, site na ụmụ  ndị ọbara, ruo na ụmụ antelopes na ụmụ deer.

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: N’ikpeazụ, e nwere ọtụtụ obere nwamba (gụnyere anụ ụlọ nwamba furu efu) na-eri ọtụtụ obere ụmụ anụmanụ dị ka ụmụ ahụhụ, oke, ngwere, na nnụnụ.
translations.hypothesis: చివరిగా, त्यहाँ আছে धेरै નાની બિલાలు (بما في ذلك حيوانات أليفة)، اللاتي يأكلن طعام الأكثر، مثل الحشرات، القوارض، السحالي، وطيور.

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Ihe nzuzo nke ọganihu ha bụ gburugburu ebe obibi, ọrụ nwamba niile ji nke na egbochi ịsọmpi ha na ndị ọzọ.
translations.hypothesis: سر النجاح שלהם заключается στηνแนวคิด של "مجال خاص"، iaitu وظيفة مميزة لكل قط، والتي تمنعها من التنافس مع الآخرين.

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Ọdụm bụ nwamba kachasị emekọrịta n'onwe ha, na-ebi na nnukwu òtù akpọrọ nganga.
translations.hypothesis: أسود هم القطط الأكثر اجتماعي، حيث يعيشون في مجموعات كبيرة المعروفة باسم "مجموعات".

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Mpako gasị bụ otu ruo atọ ụmụ nwoke tozuru oke metụtaranụ mejupụtara ya, yana ụmụ nwanyị na ụmụ ya dị ọtụtụ dị ka iri atọ.
translations.hypothesis: குழுలు מורכב מאחד עד שלו પુરষ بالغים, בנוסף למאות הנשים וצאצאים.

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Ndị nwanyị na-emetụtakarị nke ukwu n’onwe ha, n’ibu otu nnukwu ezinụlọ nke ụmụnne nwanyị na ụmụ nwa nwanyị.
translations.hypothesis: عادةً، النساءมีความสัมพันธ์ใกล้ชิดกัน, הןเป็นครอบครัวใหญ่ที่มีพี่สาวและลูกสาว.

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Ezinụlọ Ọdụm na-akpa agwa ka ezinụlọ oke nkịta ọhịa maọbụ nkịta ụlọ, anụ ndị nwere oyiyi dị ịtụ n'anya nye Ọdụm (mana odịghị otu a n'ebe nnukwu nwamba ndị ọzọ nọ) n'omume, ma bụrụ ihe oke iyi egwu nye ihe ọbụla ha na-achụ na nta.
translations.hypothesis: குழு των சிங்கங்கள், බොහෝ විට, όπως குழு των ஓநாய்கள் அல்லது நாய்கள், פעולות של בעלי חיים, אשר דומה מאוד לסינים (אך לא לבעלי חיים אחרים גדולים), וגם מאוד מסוכנות לטרף שלהם.

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Ome ihe egwuregwu zuruoke nkeoma, agu ahu ga enyili elu (obu ezie na obughi nkeoma), gwuo mmiri, maa-amaa garuo ebe di oke anya ma doo okpukpu ise dika ike mmadu di ike nwere ike ido.
translations.hypothesis: رياضي ذو مهارات, النمرสามารถปีน (хотя לא בצורהดี), سباحة, قفز مسافات طويلة, และดึงด้วย قوة خمس مراتมากกว่า قوة بشر قوية.

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Agụ nọ n’otu otu (Genus Panthera) dika ọdụm, owuru, na jaguar. Nwamba anọ ndị a bụ naanị ndị nwere ike ime mbigbọ.
translations.hypothesis: טיگرৰ, אַל, פַּנְת và جاਗुआৰ, सबैৰେકৰେক, די אַל, פַּנְת và جاਗुआৰ, हुन्। אַל, פַּנְת và جاਗुआৰ, हुन् די אַف sahaja איৰ, دەتوانन।

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Ụja agụ adịghị ka mgbọpụta n'uju ụja ọdụm, mana ọ dị nnọọ ka okwu e kwuputara n'iti mkpu.
translations.hypothesis: เสียงคำรามของเสือ bukanlah sepertiเสียงคำรามที่เต็มไปด้วยเสียงของเสือ, แต่มากกว่านั้น, זה דומהกับวลีที่เต็มไปด้วยคำที่กร้าวและตะโกน.

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Ona amasi Ocelot iri obere umu-anumanu. Ha ga anwuchi enwe, agwo, oke na nnunu ma ha nwee ike. Oka-na-onuogugu anu anumanu nile Ocelot na achu-nta di obere nnukwu karia ka odi.
translations.hypothesis: Ocelotsชอบกิน حيوانات صغيرة. إذا أمكن، فإنهم سيصطاد قرد، ثعبان، حيوانات صغيرة، وطيور. כמעט כל الحيوانات التي يصطادها Ocelot, הן أصغر بكثير مما هو.

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Ndị oke mmụta sayensị cheere na nwamba Oselọt ji isi esochi ma na-achọta anụ ha ga eri, site na ịkpọkwa imi n'ala iji site ebe ha gara.
translations.hypothesis: Ụmụ ndị Ụmụ Ụmụ Ọrụ諗ụrụ ndị Ọcelot na-ụmụ ndị ụmụ ụmụ ndị ọ bụrụ ndị wọn ụnụ, site n'ịụ ndị ụmụ ụmụ ndị wọn ụnụ, site n'ịụ ụzọ wọn tụrụ喺 ihe.

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Ha na-ahụ ụzọ nke ọma n'abalị, ma na ejegharịkwa na nzuzo karịa. Oselọotụ na agwakọta onwe ha na gburugburu ha iji nwude anụ ha na achụ.
translations.hypothesis: அவர்கள் இரவில் நன்றாகப் பார்க்க முடியும், மேலும் மிகவும் ரகசியமாக நகரவும் முடியும். ஓசெலோட் வேட்டையாட, அவர்கள் தங்கள் சுற்றுப்புறத்துடன் ஒன்றிணைந்து, பின்னர் தங்கள் இரையைத் தாக்குகிறார்கள்.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Mgbe ọbụla ụmụ obere ihe dị ndụ (obere ọnụ ọgụgụ yiri onwe ha) si na ndị otu ha pụọ (dịka ha gafee ugwu, osimiri, maọbụ gaa n'agwaetiti ọzọ ebe ọ ga-ara ahụ isi laghachi) ha ga-achọta onwe ha na gburugburu di iche ọtụtụ mgbe.
translations.hypothesis: عندما קבוצת קטנה של జీوانات (קבוצת קטנה) ถูก अलग kutoka na קבוצת העיקרית کە wọn באពី (כמו کە wọn bergerak מעל הר או נהר, או کە wọn bergerak بۆ איเกل חדש کە wọn לאสามารถ bergerak πίσω בקלות), זייมักจะ מצא עצמם لە ב वातावरण کە שונה لەوە کە זיי בא لە پێش.

translations.source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.reference: Gburugburu ọhụrụ a nwere akụrụngwa dị iche ma ndị ịsọmpi dị iche, n'ihi nke a ọnụọgụgụ ọhụrụ ahụ kwesịrị inwe akụrụngwa dị iche maọbụ ihe mmegharị ọzọ ga eme ya ka ọbụrụ onye ịsọmpi dị ike karịa ka ọdịbu.
translations.hypothesis: சுற்றுပတ်ဝန်းကျင် הזה ունịtị διαφορε적인 వనరులు καὶ διαφορε적인 คู่แข่ง, కాబట్టి, නව జပူULATION ịnị dị mkpa ị dị ọ bụrụ ndị dị ọkach nke ndị ụ dị ọ bụrụ nke ndị ụ dị ọ bụrụ.

translations.source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ nke izizi agbanwebeghị maọlị, ha ka chọrọ ihe mmegharị dịka nke mgbe mbụ.
translations.hypothesis: Становништво मूल रूप से, ממש לא बदली, wọn હજીও χρειάζονται אותן προσαρμοvanja وەল پێרי.

translations.source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.reference: Ka oge na-aga, dịka gburugburu ha ọhụrụ bidoro mawa ha ahụ, oyiyi ha na ndị ha hapụrụ ebido na-ebelata.
translations.hypothesis: لە הזمان، وە lúc జనాభా חדשەکە دەبێت אৱασן بۆ סביבה החדשה שלה, הן دەبێت אৱασן פחות আৰু פחות وە lúc జనాభా האחר.

translations.source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.reference: Mgbe puku afọ maọbụ rịị nde afọ ụfọdụ gasịrị, otu abụọ a ga adị nnọọ iche ruo oke ebe agaghịzị akpọ ha abụọ otu ụdị.
translations.hypothesis: చివరిగా, אַחרי אלף, אַף פֿעלי, או אַ miljion, די שתי קבוצות וועלן זיין אַ כך אַ כך שונה, אַז זיי קאַנאַט נישט זיין אַן אַן זאַם ספּעסי.

translations.source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.reference: Anyi na-akpọ usoro a speciation, nke pụtara nguzobe nke ụdị okike ọhụụ. Speciation bụ nsonaazụ a na-apụghị ịgbagha agbagha na akụkụ dị oke mkpa nke evolushọn.
translations.hypothesis: આપણેเรียกว่า กระบวนการนี้คือ การเกิดสายพันธุ์ใหม่, ซึ่งหมายถึงการเกิดขึ้นของสายพันธุ์ใหม่. การเกิดสายพันธุ์ใหม่เป็นผลลัพธ์ที่ไม่สามารถหลีกเลี่ยงได้ และเป็นส่วนที่สำคัญมากของวิวัฒนาการ.

translations.source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.reference: Osisi na-eme ikuku oksigin nke mmadụ na-ekuru, ma ha na e kubanye carbon-dioxide nke mmadụ na-ekufu ume (ya bụ, na-ekufu ume).
translations.hypothesis: พืชสร้างออกซิเจนซึ่ง בני אדם לנשום, וגם הם לקוח פחמןไดออกไซด์ซึ่ง בני אדם פุ่งออกมา (כלומר, לנשוף החוצה).

translations.source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.reference: Akụmakụ osisi na emepụta nri nke ha site n’anyanwụ site n’aka fotosintesis. Ha na-enyekwa ndo.
translations.hypothesis: พืชสร้างอาหาร שלהם จากแสงอาทิตย์ באמצעותกระบวนการ φωτοסינתซิส। นอกจากนี้, הן גם מספק הגנה מפניแสงแดด.

translations.source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.reference: Anyị ji osisi eme ụlọ na akwa. Ọtụtụ nri anyị na-eri bụ osisi. Ewepụ osisi, anụmanụ agaghị adị ndụ.
translations.hypothesis: අපි ගොඩනගා අපේ නිවාස, සහ අපේ ඇඳුම්, අපි භාවිතා කරන්නේ ශාක වලින්। බොහෝ ආහාර අපි ගන්න, යනු ශාක වලින්। නැතහොත් ශාක, සතුන්ට නොහැකියි ජීවත් වෙන්න.

translations.source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus bụbu isi n'anụ na-eri anụ n’oge ya, nke a mere na onweghi ihe na-atụ ya egwu, karịa mosasaurs ibe ya.
translations.hypothesis: Mosasaurus ји bụ ụdị ndị na-ụpụ nke afọ, بۆیە ọ ṅụrụ ụdị ndị ọ bụrụ, Ọ bụrụ ndị mosasaurus ndị ọzụ.

translations.source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.reference: Agba ogologo ya bụ nke emejupụtara n'iji ihe karịrị eze dị aguba-nkọ iri asaa, yana òtú òtù mmezi n'elu ọnụ ya, nke pụtara na ọ nweghị ụzọ mgbapụ maka ihe ọ bụla gafere n'ụzọ ya.
translations.hypothesis: 觜佢 લાँग, 70 दा dientes तीक्ष्ण, साथसाथ, दा अतिरिक्त दा dientes ඊก, ඊक意味, ఏది ఏది ඊก דרך, ఏది ඊก לאสามารถ தப்ப.

translations.source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.reference: Onweghị anyị anya, mana ọ dịka onwere ire abụọ. Ọ na eri mbe mmiri, nnukwu azụ, anụ ndị yiri ya, onwekwara ike na eri ụdị nke ya.
translations.hypothesis: אנחנו איננו יודעים בוודאות, אולם ייתכןว่า הוא ունה לשון מעוגלת. התזונה שלו כולל צבים, דגים גדולים, דינוזوارים אחרים, וייתכן גםว่า הוא היה צמח.

translations.source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.reference: Ọ wakpọkwara ihe ọ bụla banyere n’ime mmiri ahụ; ọbụná nnukwu dainosọọ dị ka T. rex abụghị atụ n’ebe ọ nọ.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك, היא напала על כל דבר جيڪا دخل cikin ماء; אפילו داينोस عظيم سار سار، وەเบດ T. rex, לא יغلبها.

translations.source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.reference: Ka anyị maara nke ọma imirikiti nri ha, ndị Rom nwere oke ha na ihe erimeeri ijuanya ma ọ bụ pụrụ iche, gụnyere ezi ọhịa, piikọkụ, ejula, na ụdị oke akpọrọ dormouse.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام, רוב อาหาร wọn ידע, بەلام, ڕۆମەنहरूले ވެ पनि ἔχεनु ụ dị iche ma ọ bụ dị iche, ụnụ, פּేకాక్, 𝘴𝘯𝘢𝘪𝘭, আৰু ụ ụ ụ dị iche nke dị ọnụ, nke dị ọnụ

translations.source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.reference: Ihe ọzọ dị iche bụ na ebe ndị ogbenye na nwanyị ahụ riri nri ha ka ha nọ ọdụ n'oche, ndị ọgaranya na-enwe mmasị inwe mmemme oriri ebe ha ga-eri nke ha n'ezumike.
translations.hypothesis: એક अन्य ત différenceคือ, ขณะที่ העניים וผู้หญิง ănอาหาร שלהם בזמן שהם นั่งบน כיرا, אך άνδρες העשיריםชอบจัด भोजات μαζί, όπου הם θα आरामบน הצד שלהם בזמן שהם ănอาหาร.

translations.source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.reference: Ụmụ nri Ndị Rome Ndị mgbe ochie enwughị ike ịgụnye nri ndị batara Yurop site na Amerịka ma ọ bụ Eshịa na narị afọ ndị na-esotenu.
translations.hypothesis: وجبات העתיק של الرومان לא יכלوا أن تتضمن الأطعمة التي أتت إلى أوروبا من أمريكا أو من آسيا في القرون اللاحقة.

translations.source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.reference: Na imaatu, ha enweghi oka, nweghi tomato, nweghi poteto, nweghi koko, na onweghi onye Rome mgbeochie deturu anu toro-toro ire.
translations.hypothesis: උදාහරණය,佢哋 нема有 କෝରନ୍, କେଟାମେଟෝස්, କେପଟෝස්, କିମ୍ବା କୋକෝ, ଏବଂ कुनै पनि ඈନ୍ସେଣ୍ଟ ରୋମାନ ମଧ୍ୟ ମଧ୍ୟ କେବେ ନାଟେସ୍ ଏକଟ୍ କ୍ଲୁକ।

translations.source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.reference: Ndị Babịlọn rụrụ otu n’ime chi ha otu isi ụlọ nsọ nke e were ka ebe obibi chi ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: ชาวบาबिलोनได้สร้าง מקום פולחannya لكل إله، والذي كان يعتبر مكان الإله.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Ebe ndị mmadụ wetaara chi ndị ahụ aja, ndị nchụ aja ahụ maka ihe ha bụ chi na-achọ, site n'emume na mmemme di iche iche.

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Ụfọdụ oge a na arụnye ụlọ elu nwere oyiyi oiramid, ndị akpọrọ ziggurats, ka ha bụrụ osonye ụlọ okpukpe.
translations.hypothesis: بەسبەش، لەکۆمپ لەسەردە, کە پێبڵێن دەكرێتەوە کە "זיگurat", دەكرێت بۆ ئەوەی دەبێتە بە بەشێک لە כێڵ.

translations.source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.reference: Elu ụlọ elu a bụ ebe dị nsọ pụrụ iche nye chi ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: bahagian העליון של برجนั้น היה מקום מיוחד барои אלוהี.

translations.source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.reference: Na ekpem-oku nke udidi na mba ndi etiti owuwa-anyanwu, ulo ahu abachaghi uru.
translations.hypothesis: لە وشي వాతావరణ لە ڕۆژ الوسط، הౌస్ אי није ממש مهم.

translations.source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ ihe ezinụlọ ndị juu a mere, ọ bụ n'anya onye ọbụla ka ha mere ya.
translations.hypothesis: بەส่วนมาก, איבער פון איבער, איבער פון איבער

translations.source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị siri nri na mbara eze; ụmụ ụlọ ahịa wụbụ naanị ọgụego mepere emepe na-elefe anya n'okporo ámá. E jire okwute maka ịrụ ụlọ.
translations.hypothesis: 여성들은 בחצר בישול; חנויות היו פשוט דוכานות פתוחות, צופה על הרחוב. אבן נעשה שימוש כדי לבנות בתים.

translations.source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.reference: O nweghị ụmụ ọhịa buru ibu n’ala nke Keenan, ya mere osisi na-ada oke ọnụ.
translations.hypothesis: איןป่าใหญ่ במדינה של קनान, ดังนั้น העץ היה מאוד יקר.

translations.source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.reference: Ndị mmadụ anọjughị otu ebe na Grinland. N'akụkọ Norse ha sị na achụfuru Erik the Red n'obodo Iceland n'ihi igbu ọchụ, ma mgbe ọ na aga njem na mgbada ọdịda anyanwụ, ọchọpụtara Grinland wee gụọ ya Grinland.

translations.source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: Agbanyeghị, nke ahụ abụghị eziokwu. N’agbanyeghị na enwere ihe edere n’azụ nke dọkumentị ahụ, ọ bụghị otu maapụ akụ.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام، بەڵام ئەوە אינێ. แม้ว่า त्यहाँ מێదụม لە מאחריเอกสาร, بەڵام אינێแผนที่สำหรับการค้นหาสมบัติ.

translations.source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.reference: Ka-edere na azu nkwuputa nke nnoro-onwe bu okwua “Nkwuputa nke Nnoro-onwe Nke bu ezie ubochi abali 4 juli 1776” .Ederede ahu putara na ala-ala akwukwo ahu, kpodo isi na-ala.
translations.hypothesis: על ظهر הצהרת עצמאות, היו عبارات "צהרת עצמאות الأصلية، بتاريخ 4 يوليو 1776". النص يظهر على الجزء السفلي من الوثيقة، ولكن הפוך.

translations.source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.reference: Ọ bụ ezie na ọnweghị onye maara nke ọma onye dere ya, amaara na mmalite na ndụ ya, afụkọtara nnukwu dọkụment e jiri akpụkpọ anụ mee (o nwere nha inchì 29¾ site na inchì 24½) ọnụ maka nchekwa.
translations.hypothesis: بەلام, אינאָ קายị ụ dị ụ, אָমị, ịnụ ụ dị ụ (ịnụ 29¾ איંચ על 24½ איંચ), dị ụ dị ụ.

translations.source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.reference: Ya mere, ọ dị ka agbakwụnyere ihe ngosi a dị ka akara njirimara naanị.
translations.hypothesis: ஆகையால், סבירว่า סימןนั้น הוצבו פשוט כعلامת.

translations.source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.reference: Ubochi-ubochi nladata ya agha ndi na esota atohapula mpaghara ugwu nke France, mana mpaghara ndida enwerebekwa onwe ha.
translations.hypothesis: การลงพลัดพ่ายในวันที่ D และการต่อสู้ต่อไปได้ปลดปล่อยภาคเหนือของฝรั่งเศส, แต่ภาคใต้ยังคงไม่ได้รับอิสรภาพ.

translations.source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.reference: Ndị chịrị ya bụ ndị "Vichy" French. Ndị a bụ ndị mba Frans ndị ha na ndị mba Jamini mere udo n'afọ 1940 ma soro ndị iro rụkọọ ọrụ karịa ịlụso ha ọgụ.

translations.source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.reference: N'ụbọchị nke iri na ise nke ọnwa Ọgọọstụ n'afọ 1940, ndị enyi busoro mpaghara ndịda nke Frans agha, akpọrọ nke a "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: Ịnụ 15 Ọgọ 1940, ndị Ẹzónu Ọgụghọ ọnụ, họọrọ ọnụ France, ihe ndị ahụ họọrọ "Ọrụ Dragoon".

translations.source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.reference: N'ime nanị izu abụọ ndị agha America na Ndị French nke Nweere onwe ha emeela ka ndịda France nwere onwe ha ma wee na-atụgharị echewe ihu na Germany.
translations.hypothesis: cikin פחות שבועיים, הצבא האמריקאי וצבא הצרפתים החופשיים שחררו צפון צרפת, ועתה הם פונים לעבר גרמניה.

translations.source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.

translations.source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.reference: Ahịrịokwu "civilization" si n'okwu Latin bụ civilis, nke pụtara "gbasara obodo", nke metụtara okwu Latin bụ civis, nke pụtara onye obodo, na civitas, nke pụtara obodo maọbụ obodo-steeti, nke ahụ nwekwara otu o si egosi nha nke ọha mmadụ.
translations.hypothesis: كلمة "सांस्कृतिक" এসেছে লাতিন भाषा "सिविलिस", जिसका अर्थ है "सांस्कृतिक", जो مرتبط है עם লাতিন शब्द "सिविस", जिसका अर्थ है "नागरिक", और "सिविटাস", जिसका अर्थ है "शहर" या "शहर-राज्य", మరియు ఇది కూడా באופן काहीतरी समाजों పరిమాణను నిర్వచిస్తుంది.

translations.source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.reference: Steeti-obodo gasị bụ obu ụzọ nke ụmụ mba. Omenaala kemmepeanya pụtara nnyefe nke ihe ọmụma n'etiti ọtụtụ ọgbọ, akaraụkwụ omenaala nke ka nọ ya na mgbasa dịtụ mma.

translations.source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.reference: Ụmụ obere ọdịnala na-apụ n'anya na-ahapụghị ihe akaebe dị mkpa ya mere anaghị ahụta ha dị ka sivilaịzeshọn kwesịrị ekwesị.
translations.hypothesis: सांस्कृतिक समूह નાનું, ઘણીવાર исчезаютबिना छोडने कोई प्रासंगिक ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण, અને असफल होते हैं।

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: Ka a na alụ agha ntụgharị, steeti iri na atọ ahụ bu ụzọ gbakọọ bido gọọmenti nchịkọta nke na adịghị ike - nke nzukọ bụ sọ ngalaba onwere- n'okpuru akwụkwọ obodo.
translations.hypothesis: لە شەڕ הפירוৱ, אַתן אַحەشәр دولहरू פעם צור אַ ממשל מרכז слабы—بە אי काँग्रेस כאַفעל единствен घटक—لە בסיס ל Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.reference: Nzukọ enweghị ike ike ụtụ ma n'ihi na enweghi ndị isi ọchịchị gọọmenti etiti maọbụ ndị omeiwu, ọ dabeere na ndị isi ọchịchị steeti, ndị anaghị enwe otu obi ọtụtụ oge ịkwado iwu ya nile.
translations.hypothesis: مجلس التشريعيไม่มี أي سلطة لفرض الضرائب، و،เนื่องจากไม่มี ממשלชาติหรือศาล, จึงพึ่งพาหน่วยงานรัฐ, ซึ่งมักจะไม่ให้ความร่วมมือ, เพื่อบังคับใช้กฎหมายทั้งหมดของตน.

translations.source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.reference: O nweghi ikike imechi iwu ụtụisi na tarifu n'etiti steeti na steeti.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، איננו יש לו כוח כדי לבטל חוקי מס ומיסים ביןรัฐต่างๆ.

translations.source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.reference: Ederede ahụ chọrọ nkweta steeti niile n'enweghi mgbagha tupu enwee ike imezi ha ma steeti ga weere gọọmentị etiti n'ihe efu ruo na ndị nnọchiteanya ha anaghị abịa.
translations.hypothesis: القوانين απαιτούσαν συναίνεση πλήρης από όλες τις πολιτείες πριν μπορέσουν να τροποποιηθούν, και οι πολιτείες αντιμετώλησαν ממשלת المركز ως κάτι незначительное, έτσι ώστεप्रतिनिधниками שלהם συχνά לא היו présents.

translations.source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.reference: Ndị otu egwuregwu bọọlụ ukwu nke mba Itali, ya na ndị otu egwuregwu bọọlụ ukw nke mba Jamani bu ndị kacha eme nke ọma n'otu bọọlụ ukwu na mbaụwa ma bụrụkwa ndị nwetara mmeri n’iko mbaụwa nke afo 2006.
translations.hypothesis: فريق كرة القدم الوطني الإيطالي, μαζί עם فريق كرة القدم الوطني الألمانية, הוא الفريق الأكثر نجاح في العالم, و هو الفريق الفائز في كأس العالم الفيفا عام 2006.

translations.source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu ndị a ma ama gụnyere futbọl, basketbọl, volleybọl, polo-mmiri, fencing, rugby, ịgba ịnyịnya, hockey ice, hockey roller na ịgba ọsọ ụgbọ ala F1.
translations.hypothesis: ك్రీدا المشهورة مش شاملين: كرة القدم، كرة السلة، كرة الطائرة، كرة الماء، فن المبارزة، رغبي، ركوب الدراجة، هوكي على الجليد، هوكي على عجلة، وسباق سيارات F1.

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Egwuregwu oge oyi kachasị ewu ewu n'ugwu, ebe ndị mba Italy so asọ mpi n'egwuregwu mba na mba makwa na Olimpik.
translations.hypothesis: ك్రీات الشتاء هى الأكثر شعبية في المناطق الشمالية، حيث الإيطاليين يشاركوا في مباريات دولية والأحداث الأولمبية.

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: Mba Japan nwere isuo ruru nde asaa (nke kachasị ibu bụ isuo Honshu), nke a mere mba Japan isuo nke asaa kacha ibu n'ụwa.
translations.hypothesis: ญี่ปุ่น  adunay כמעט 7,000 איים (הגדול ביותר הוא Honshu), מה שהופך ญี่ปุ่น ל-7 האי הגדול ביותר בעולם!

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: N’ihi mkọkụlọta/òtù agwaetiti ahụ Japan nwere, a na-arụnyekarị Japan aka, n’elu etu ala ndị ahụ sị guzogide, dị ka "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: بەकारणว่าญี่ปાન דווקא דווקא, ญี่ปાન، لە ڕوואڵ، دەبێتە "جزایر"

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Mbido mmepe Taịwan malitere n’oge gara aga nke narị afọ iri na ise mgbe ndị ọkwụ ụgbọ mmiri Ndị Yurop na-agafe dekọrọ aha agwaetiti ahụ dị ka Ilha Formosa, ma ọ bụ agwaetiti mara mma.
translations.hypothesis: טאইوان, אירופה, התחלה מוקדם, בשנת 15, כאשר البحارة האירופאיون, أثناء عبورهم, سجلوا اسم الجزيرة כـ "Ilha Formosa" (جزيرة جميلة).

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: N'afọ 1624, Ụlọọrụ Dọch Isti Indịa mepere ụlọọrụ na ndịda ọdịdaanyanwụ Taịwan, bido mgbanwe n'otu e si emepụta mkpụrụ n'oge gboo, ma wee ndị ọkpọkọọrụ Chaịna ka ha rụọ ọrụ n'ugbo osikapa na nke shuga ha.
translations.hypothesis: لە ساৰ 1624، کۆمپانی ئەندرا ڕۆји، وای لە אַזור דቡৱ מערב טایوان، ناپاڕێت، ואי شروع לשינוৱাৰ لە ڕێڵەکانی פאַרוואৰ، وە ناپاڕێت אַسایین لە פאַרוואৰ ריس و סאַگر.

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: Na 1895, mgbe a dachara n’Agha Sino-Japanese Mbụ (1894-1895), ọchịchị Qing ahụ mere mbịanye aka na Nkwekọrịta nke Shimonoseki ahụ, site na nke o jiri nyefee Japan ọbụbụeze nke Taiwan, nke na-achị agwaetiti ahụ ruo 1945.
translations.hypothesis: لە ساৰ 1895، पاش ماجراแรก ביन् סיنا-جাপان (1894-1895)، حكومت Qing ناڕا پەкту Shimonoseki, لەلایەن דא، کە ناڕا ҳуқуқ لە Taiwan بۆญี่ปەن، کە ناڕا האיలా עד 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu nwere ọdịdị atọ, ya bụ Intihuatana, Ụlọ Nsọ nke Anyanwu, yana Ime ụlọ nke Windo Atọ.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu ರು तीन मुख्य संरचना, iaitu Intihuatana, מקุฏ Ọkụ, һәм ụkwụ ụmụ atọ, nke dị iche iche.

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Ọ dịtụ mgbagwoju anya na, n'ezie, ụdịdị 35mm nwere 36mm n'obosara na 24mm n'ogo.
translations.hypothesis: ఫార్మాట్ 35มม. నిజానికి, באופן מעור, הוא 36มม. వెడịและ 24มม. גובה.

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: akuku rashio nke usoro a ( iji iri na-abuo were nweta rashio onu ogugu dikasiri mfe) bu 3:2 maka nke a.
translations.hypothesis: نسبة זו (باستخدام عدد 12 כדי לקבל نسبة ամենափשוט, पूर्ण संख्या) కాబట్టి, אומרว่า היא 3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Ọtụtụ usoro nkịtị (dịka usoro APS si n'otu ezinaụlọ) ga-abụ otu ihe maọbụ ruo ihe dịka nkepụta nkewa a.
translations.hypothesis: ઘણા phổ biếnรูปแบบ (જેમ કે משפחה של APS, למשל), שווה או קרוב מאוד לنسبת הזה.

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Iwu nke atọ ndị a na-akparị ma na-akwakarị oke emu bụ usoro dị mfe na-emepụta ịdịmgbanwò dị ka ọ na-edotekwa otu ụhara usoro ọrụ n'ime otu onyinyo.

translations.hypothesis: القوة העצומה ذي أثر على الجميع، من الملك إلى عامة الناس.

translations.source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.reference: Otu n'ime isi okwu okwukwe Ndị Kristian bu na ekwesiri iji akụ belata nhụjuanya na ịda ogbenye nakwa na ego ụka nọ kpọmkwem ebe ahụ n'ihi nke ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: એક מהમુખ્ય หลักศาสന христианીય, הואว่า ثرواتควร использоваться כדיลดความทุกข์และความยากจน, และว่า الأموال المالية للكنيسة موجودة تحديدًا لهذا الغرض.

translations.source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.reference: Ikike keetiti ahụ nke ụlọ uka anọọla n'ime Rom karịa otu puku afọ ma mkpọkọnata ike na ego a duru ọtụtụ ndị ịjụ sị ma a na-esokwa ụkpụrụ ya.
translations.hypothesis: السلطة المركزية للكنيسة كانت موجودة في روما لأكثر من ألف سنة، وتركيز هذه السلطة ومال أدى إلى أن العديد من الناس بدأوا לשאלה אם هذا المبدأ يتم تنفيذه.

translations.source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.reference: Ka agha dara, mba Britenị jiri ndị agha elu mmiri gbochie ndị Jamani inweta enyemaka
translations.hypothesis: לאחר התחילสงคราม, בריطانیہเริ่มปิด блокаד بحرية על גרመን

translations.source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: Atụmatụ ahụ rụrụ ọrụ ọfụma, na-ebepụ ụmụ ihe mbute ihe ndị agha na ndị nkiti dị oke mpka, n’agbanyeghị na mgbochi a dara iwu mba ụwa anabatara n’izugbe nke ọtụtụ nkwekọrịta n’etiti mba ụwa nke afọ narị abụọ gara aga nyere ikikere.
translations.hypothesis: रणनीति सफल оказалось, โดยการقطعแหล่งเสบียง צבאי וพล民 החיוני, למרות שהבל็อก הזה הפר חוק בינלאומי הנפוץ,ซึ่งถูก תיעוד על ידי כמה הסכמי בינלאומייםในช่วง שנתיים האחרונות.

translations.source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.

translations.hypothesis: בריطانیہ قام باستخراج معدن في المياه הבינלאומי כדי למنع أي سفينة من الدخول إلى أقسام كاملة من المحيط، مما يسبب خطر حتى للسفن المحايدة.

translations.source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: N'afọ 1884, Tesla kwagara na mba Amerịka ịnara ọrụ na nke Ụlọ ọrụ Edison n'Obodo Niu Yọk.
translations.hypothesis: cikin 1884, Tesla lọ na oru ka ọrụ na kọmpaniya Edison na New York City.

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Ọ bịarutere na US n’inwe centị anọ n’aha ya, otu akwụkwọ nke uri, ya na otu akwụkwọ ozi nke nkwanye sitere na Charles Batchelor (onye njikwa ya n’ọrụ ya gara aga) ruo Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: அவர் அமெரிக்காவிற்கு 4 சென்ட் பணத்துடன், ஒரு கவிதை புத்தகம், மற்றும் சார்லஸ் பேட்சலர் (அவரது முந்தைய வேலைतील மேலாளர்) నుండి தாமஸ் எடிசன் προς, ஒரு பரிந்துரை கடிதத்துடன் வந்தார்.

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: Chaịna ndị mgbe ochie nwere ụzọ pụrụ iche igosi oge afọ; ogo ọbụla nke Chaịna ma ọ bụ ezinụlọ ọ bụla nọbụrụ n’ọchịchị wụbụ oge ọchịchị eze pụrụ iche.
translations.hypothesis: चीन העתיקה ունה דרך ייחודית ؤلعرض فترات زمني مختلفة؛ كل مرحلة ؤلعين أو كل عائلة ؤالتي كانت في السلطة، كانت إمبراطورية مميزة.

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Nakwa n’etiti usoro ndị eze ọ bụla bụ otu oge ejighị n'aka mke mpaghara ndị kewara ekewa. Oge ndị a nke a kacha mara amara bụ oge nke Alaeze Atọ nke mere ruo afọ iri na isii n'etiti Usoro Ndị Eze Han na Usoro Ndị Eze Jin ndị ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: এছাড়াও, בין כל राजวงศ์, הייתה תקופה نااستabila של مقاطعات הפצیده. תקופה הידוע ביותר מבין هذه هي תקופת الثلاث ممالك، التي استمرت لمدة 60 عامًا بينราชวงศ์ هان وราชวงศ์ جين.

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: N'oge ndị a, a lụrụ ọtụtụ agha n'etiti ndi ukwu na-azọ oche eze.
translations.hypothesis: لە ​​यी अव, شەڕ धेरै राजाहहरूले সিং ​​بەدەڵە بۆ, धेरै شەڕҳо ڕووە.

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: Alaeze Atọ so n'otu n'ime ọgbọ kacha dị egwu n'akụkọ ihe mere na mba Chaịna mgbe gboo. Puku kwuru puku mmadụ nwụrụ n'agha ịnọ n'oche ọchịchị nke kachasị elu na nnukwu obi eze nke dị na Xi'an.

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Nke a butere ọtụtụ mmetụta na mmekọ mmadụ na ibe ya makwa na ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị dika usoro agụm ọnụ, mgbanwe site n'ọchịchị okwu otu onye gaa na nke okwu mba, nke obodo na nkwenye na obodo bụ nke ọha karịa ịbụ nke otu onye ọchịchị.
translations.hypothesis: โภ, มีผลกระทบทางสังคมและทางการเมืองมากมาย, ଯଥା ການ օգ용ระบบແມตრიକ୍, ການสลับຈາກระบอบเผด็จການ ଥା ລະบอบสาธารณะ, ජාතිකවා, ଏବଂ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଯେ ଦେଶର ණය ଥା ଲୋକ, ନାହିଁ ଏକຜູ້ବାżą।

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Ọzọkwa mgbe ụmụ aka ọrụ Mgbanwe ọchịchị ahụ mepechara maka ụmụ nwoke ọchọ ọrụ niile na-ekwe ka ndị kacha nwee oké ọchịchọ na ihe ịga nke ọma ka ha gaa nke ọma.
translations.hypothesis: علاوة على ذلك، بعد الثورة، הזדواياتเปิดให้กับผู้สมัครทั้งหมด، โดยเฉพาะผู้ที่มีความทะเยอทะยานและประสบความสำเร็จมากที่สุด.

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Ọ bụkwa otu ihe ahụ n'amị, maka na kama nhazi n'usoro nke ndị amị ga-adabere n'ogugo, ọ daberezie n'ikikere.
translations.hypothesis: একই דבר लागू হয় לצבא, কারণ במקוםให้ رتبة الجيش تعتمد على الطبقة، الآن يتم تحديدها بناءً على مهارت.

translations.source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.reference: Mgbanwe France melitere obi ndi oru ana emegbu emegbu no gasi na mba ndi ozo ha ewere wee ike ibido mgbanwe nke ha.
translations.hypothesis: מהפכות צרפת גם вдохновила многие другие люди из других стран, जो были угнетаемые, כדי להתחיל свои собственные революции.

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: Muhammad nwere ezigbo mmasị n’ụmụ okwu gabigara ụwa a na-agwụ ike. Ọ dịbụ na-agakarị n’otu nnukwu ọnụala nke emechara mara dị ka “Hira‘” n’ugwu nke “Noor” (light) maka ntụgharị ụche.
translations.hypothesis: ሙহাম্মাদले ஆழంగా ఆసక్తి имел విషయాల जो इस साधारण जीवन से परे। הואเคย తరచుగా एक गुफा में जाती, जो "ஹिरा'" के नाम से प्रसिद्ध हुआ, जो "نوور" (प्रकाश) पर्वत पर स्थित है, ताकि वह चिंतन कर सके।

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: ọgba ahụ n'onwe ya, nke lanarịrị oge ndị a, na-enye ezigbo ihe ngosi maka echiche gbasara ihe mmụọ nke Muhammad.

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: N'ezie, ọ dịghị mfe maọlị ịchọta, ọbụrụgodi na mmadụ maara na ọ dị. Ozugbo abanyere n'ime ọgba ahụ, ọ bụ ndịpụ kpam kpam.
translations.hypothesis: உண்மையில், ακόμη যদি ஒருவர் அதைக் જાણે, તે కనుగొనడం చాలా కష్టం. ఒకసారి గుহೆಯ లోపలికి, అది पूर्णంగా ఒంటరితనం.

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: O nweghị ihe ọzọ enwere ike ịhụ na-abụghị eluigwe dị n’elu gbachapụrụ, maa mma na ọtụtụ ugwu gbara gburugburu. Nanị obere nke ụwa ka enwere ike ịhụ ma ọ bụ nụ site n’ime nnukwu ọnụala ahụ.
translations.hypothesis: אין דברដែលអាច ראה חוץ מןฟ้า స్పష్టവും అందమైన, וגם הרים רביםรอบๆ. אין הרבה מהدنিয়া הזהដែលអាច ראה או שሙ בתוך cikin.

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: Oke Piramid na Giza bụ naanị nke ka kwụ taa n'ime ihe itụnanya asaa ahụ.
